The harness-home file keeps the `user-global` scope key that earlier sessions recorded; the shared file carries `agents-global`, and reconciliation probes both roots on resume, so an external edit, a removal, or a newly created file appears as a change notice instead of a new baseline.

A user-global scope directory is an internal reconciliation key, so it stays out of model-visible prose: a global delta states `These user-global instructions apply to all work.` instead of naming a scope directory, and a project path whose first component would collide with one renders with a leading `.` so it keeps its own scope.

`USER_GLOBAL_DIRECTORIES` fixes the root order, and discovery, baseline reconciliation, and deduplication all iterate it. The harness home therefore decides content duplicates and keeps its position in the baseline, while distinct content from the shared root follows it.
en.alt:
**Replace the harness-home file with the shared root.** The harness home owns DSH-specific configuration, and its `AGENTS.md` is the user-global file the package documents, tests, and renders today. Removing it would drop a DSH-only layer for anyone who shares instructions across tools, and sessions that recorded `user-global` state would lose their referent.

**Load the shared root only when the harness-home file is absent.** The two files then alternate as the session-visible user-global file, which makes a DSH-specific file silently suppress the shared one instead of composing with it.

**Load the shared file as a second candidate name in the harness home.** `instructionFileCandidates` names files within one directory; the two roots are different directories, so the option cannot express this chain without redefining candidate semantics.

**Rely on path identity instead of content for the duplicate case.** The common layout is `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` symlinked to `~/.agents/AGENTS.md`, which is two paths for one file. Path identity drops neither, so the same text would render twice under two display labels.
en.cs:
- Shared instructions load without a copy or symlink, and the symlinked layout still renders once, from the harness home.
- A session that started before this change receives one transition when the shared file exists with content that differs from the harness-home file.
- `dsh-agent-instructions` exposes no `dshHome` or `agentsHome` config field; its two roots are process policy. `dsh-skill-filesystem` retains its explicit home fields, which select that provider's own skill roots.
- The two user-global files share one fate on probe failure: the group preserves its last-good state together, because one digest decides which member renders.
- `packages/context/agent-instructions/tests/agent-instructions.spec.ts` pins the two-root order, content deduplication, duplicate promotion after the retained candidate changes or disappears, the global delta wording, the `replace` and `remove` transitions, `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME` resolution, the `~/.agents` display label, and the escaped project directory name.

zh.t: 共享 agents 根目录加入用户全局指令链
zh.p: DSH 只加载一个用户全局指令文件：`$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`。同时使用多个 agent 工具的人，会把跨工具共享的指令放在共享 agent 配置根目录（`~/.agents/AGENTS.md`，或 `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME`）——`dsh-skill-filesystem` 已经在该根目录下扫描 skill。这些指令只有被复制或 symlink 到 harness home 之后才能进入 DSH，这会把唯一真源复制进 DSH 自有数据，也让人无法判断会话加载的是哪一份。
zh.dc:
用户全局指令 scope 有两个有序根目录：先是 `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`，然后是 `<agentsHome>/AGENTS.md`。指令加载器从 `$DSH_HOME` 或 `~/.dsh` 解析 harness home，从 `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME` 或 `~/.agents` 解析 `agentsHome`。`dsh-home-paths` 中的 `resolveAgentsHome` 与 `agentsHomeDisplay` 为 `dsh-agent-instructions` 和 `dsh-skill-filesystem` 共同负责该解析，因此共享根目录只有一个解析器，其波浪号展开与空白环境变量处理都与 harness home 一致。

这两个文件是同一个候选组中的候选：按去除首尾空白后的内容去重，完全相同的副本只从 harness home 渲染一次，候选不可观测时保留该组最后一次成功状态。预算保留内容的重复候选仍参与对账，因此保留的候选被删除或改变时它会被提升为可见；字节预算省略会让该候选及其内容重复项不再被探测。harness home 文件保留更早会话记录过的 `user-global` scope key；共享文件使用 `agents-global`。对账在恢复会话时会探测两个根目录，因此外部编辑、移除或新建文件都会表现为变更通知，而不会重新生成基线。

用户全局 scope 目录是对账用的内部 key，因此不会进入模型可见文本：全局增量声明 `These user-global instructions apply to all work.`，而不指名 scope 目录；首段路径与 scope 目录同名的项目路径会带前导 `.` 渲染，从而保留自己的 scope。

根目录顺序由 `USER_GLOBAL_DIRECTORIES` 固定，发现、基线对账与去重都按它迭代。因此由 harness home 决定内容重复项，并在基线中保持自己的位置；共享根目录中内容不同的文件排在其后。
zh.alt:
**用共享根目录替换 harness home 文件。** harness home 存放 DSH 专有配置，其 `AGENTS.md` 是该包当前记录、测试并渲染的用户全局文件。移除它会剥夺跨工具共享指令者的 DSH 专有层，也会让记录了 `user-global` 状态的会话失去指涉对象。

**仅当 harness home 文件不存在时才加载共享根目录。** 这样两个文件会轮流充当会话可见的用户全局文件，使 DSH 专有文件静默压制共享文件，而不是与之组合。

**把共享文件作为 harness home 中的第二个候选名加载。** `instructionFileCandidates` 命名的是同一个目录内的文件；这两个根目录是不同目录，因此该选项无法表达这条指令链，除非重新定义候选语义。

**重复项改用路径标识而非内容判断。** 常见布局是把 `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` symlink 到 `~/.agents/AGENTS.md`，这是同一个文件的两个路径。路径标识无法丢弃其中任何一个，同一段文本会以两个显示标签渲染两次。
zh.cs:
- 共享指令无需复制或 symlink 即可加载；symlink 布局仍然只从 harness home 渲染一次。
- 在此变更之前启动的会话，若共享文件存在且内容与 harness home 文件不同，会收到一次变更通知。
- `dsh-agent-instructions` 不暴露 `dshHome` 或 `agentsHome` 配置字段；它的两个根目录属于进程策略。`dsh-skill-filesystem` 保留显式 home 字段，用于选择该提供方自身的 skill 根目录。
- 探测失败时两个用户全局文件共享同一命运：整个组一起保留最后一次成功状态，因为决定哪个成员渲染的是同一个 digest。
- `packages/context/agent-instructions/tests/agent-instructions.spec.ts` 固定了两个根目录的顺序、内容去重、保留候选改变或消失后的重复项提升、全局增量措辞、`replace` 与 `remove` 变更、`$DSH_AGENTS_HOME` 解析、`~/.agents` 显示标签，以及转义后的项目目录名。

en.t: Preserve Web and Desktop plugin identities across experimental consolidation
en.p: Moving a capability into the experimental directory changes its ownership and support classification. Renaming its published package or an existing configuration row additionally changes how installed profiles refer to that capability. Those identity changes can make a working Web or Desktop customization require edits unrelated to the capability's behavior.
en.dc:
The moved packages retain the published names declared by the [experimental naming policy](../../../../scripts/experimental-package-policy.ts). That typed directory-to-name map is the sole maintained inventory of naming exceptions. Package manifests, consumers, installation checks, and bundler checks agree with it; a missing, moved, or duplicated exception is rejected. [Experimental status](../../../../packages/experimental/README.md#status) remains independent of spelling, Official discovery, and explicit selection.

Existing badge, Ralph, and native delegation row IDs remain valid Host row selectors. New isolation groups and newly introduced capabilities retain their new IDs. Later user layers still replace configuration or disable rows. Selecting an optional bundle is still explicit: a patch targeting an absent row does not select its bundle.

Compatibility protection covers Web and Desktop profiles, including existing native provider package identities, selections, configuration, and authentication. Native bundles insert ordinary Host rows, so Headless, SDK, and ACP compositions can select them too; separate provider-only compatibility wrappers are unnecessary. Public APIs remain pre-stable, and new output metadata stays required unless an actual consumer needs an accommodation.
en.alt:
**Rename every package and row during consolidation.** Uniform spelling makes the new ownership visible, but adds dependency and configuration migration to a change that can preserve those references.

**Publish aliases or keep duplicate compatibility rows.** Parallel identities need continuing resolution and removal rules and can register the same capability twice. Retaining the established identity avoids that additional mechanism.

**Keep provider-only bundles through additional wrapper packages.** Native bundles insert ordinary Host rows that compose into any profile. Extra delivery packages would preserve compositions outside the selected compatibility scope and increase catalog and release maintenance.
en.cs:
The repository carries a bounded naming-exception map and tests that classify retained names through direct imports, aliases, transitive dependencies, and packed or bundled artifacts. An unprefixed name does not grant admission to the default product. Existing row identities have Web/Desktop composition coverage for user overrides and disabled state. No general alias or automatic profile migration mechanism is introduced.

The [classification decision](../process/2026-10-05-product-package-classification.md), [optional-composition decision](2026-09-21-experimental-capabilities-as-optional-bundles.md), and [on-demand discovery decision](2026-10-05-official-on-demand-bundles.md) retain their separate responsibilities. Released Session generations and persisted hook event names remain protected independently of this profile compatibility scope.

zh.t: 在实验能力整合中保留 Web 和 Desktop 插件身份
zh.p: 把能力迁入 experimental 目录会改变其归属和支持分类。重命名已发布的包或既有配置行，还会改变已安装 profile 引用该能力的方式。这些身份变化可能要求正常工作的 Web 或 Desktop 自定义配置进行与能力行为无关的修改。
zh.dc:
迁移的包保留[实验包命名策略](../../../../scripts/experimental-package-policy.ts)声明的已发布名称。这个带类型的目录到包名映射是命名例外唯一手工维护的清单。包清单、消费者、安装检查和打包检查与其保持一致；缺失、迁移到其他位置或重复归属的例外会被拒绝。[实验状态](../../../../packages/experimental/README.zh.md#status)仍独立于名称拼写、Official 发现和显式选择。

既有徽章、Ralph 和原生委派行 ID 作为 Host 行选择器保持有效。新增隔离组和新引入的能力保留各自的新 ID。后续用户层仍可替换配置或禁用行。可选 bundle 仍须显式选择：指向缺失行的 patch 不会自动选择其 bundle。

兼容性保护覆盖 Web 和 Desktop profile，包括既有原生提供方的包身份、选择状态、配置和认证。原生 bundle 插入普通 Host 行，因此 Headless、SDK 和 ACP 组合也可以选择它们；不需要单独的仅提供方兼容包装包。公共 API 仍处于稳定前阶段，新增输出元信息保持必填，除非实际消费者需要适配。
zh.alt:
**在整合时重命名所有包和配置行。** 统一拼写可以体现新归属，但会为本可保留引用的变更加上依赖和配置迁移。

**发布别名或保留重复兼容行。** 并行身份需要持续维护解析和移除规则，还可能重复注册同一能力。保留既有身份可以避免增加这种机制。

**通过额外包装包保留仅提供方 bundle。** 原生 bundle 插入普通 Host 行，可组合到任何 profile。额外交付包会保留选定兼容范围之外的组合，并增加目录和发布维护成本。
zh.cs:
仓库维护范围明确的命名例外映射，并测试通过直接导入、别名、传递依赖及打包产物识别这些保留名称。没有实验前缀的名称不因此获准进入默认产品。既有行身份具有覆盖用户配置和禁用状态的 Web/Desktop 组合测试。不引入通用别名或自动 profile 迁移机制。

[分类决策](../process/2026-10-05-product-package-classification.zh.md)、[可选组合决策](2026-09-21-experimental-capabilities-as-optional-bundles.zh.md)和[按需发现决策](2026-10-05-official-on-demand-bundles.zh.md)继续承担各自独立的职责。已发布 Session 代际和持久化 hook 事件名的保护独立于此 profile 兼容范围。

en.t: Desktop shell configuration independent of the Host
en.p: Desktop updates and native recovery can run before the Host starts or while it is unavailable. Depending on Host configuration prevents these functions from resolving their preferences when needed. A shared settings page does not identify which process owns each preference.
en.dc:
Electron main owns `userData/desktop/settings.json` independently of Host startup and Cordis evaluation. The test authentication popup switch uses this file; the [Desktop reference](../../../../apps/desktop/README.md#local-desktop-settings) owns its fields and behavior.

Ownership follows runtime dependencies: Electron-owned functions needing configuration before Host startup or while the Host is unavailable use shell configuration. Host plugin settings, including shared Web/Desktop preferences, continue to use Cordis. Displaying a setting in Desktop alone does not justify shell ownership. A unified settings interface can use separate storage owners.

The `desktop` subdirectory groups shell configuration without relocating existing files. The [shortcut decision](2026-09-20-device-local-shortcut-preferences.md) retains ownership of `userData/keybindings.json` and its persistence semantics. The [shared Web application decision](2026-09-10-desktop-web-wrapper.md) still governs Host composition and profile configuration.
en.alt:
**Put every preference in Cordis.** This requires a working Host. Reading `cordis.patch.yml` directly in Electron duplicates configuration evaluation; a patch alone omits plugin defaults and other configuration layers.

**Move every setting shown in Desktop.** Interface placement does not imply a Host-independent requirement. This splits shared Web/Desktop preferences and moves configuration away from its consuming plugins.
en.cs:
Shell and Host configuration have separate owners. Each setting needs documented ownership and effective timing. Independent shell configuration supports additional Host-independent functions without introducing a second application backend.

Existing settings are candidates for individual evaluation when their functionality changes or a Host-independent use is required. This is an evaluation direction, not a scheduled migration or predefined list. A migration must identify a single authoritative source, transfer existing values and define when changes take effect, without ambiguous precedence between two stores. Shared Host-managed settings remain in Cordis unless their ownership requirements change.

zh.t: Desktop 壳层配置独立于 Host
zh.p: Desktop 更新和原生恢复可以在 Host 启动前或不可用时运行。依赖 Host 配置会使这些功能无法在需要时解析偏好。统一设置页面不能决定每项偏好由哪个进程负责。
zh.dc:
Electron 主进程负责 `userData/desktop/settings.json`，不依赖 Host 启动或 Cordis 求值。测试鉴权弹窗开关使用此文件；[Desktop 参考文档](../../../../apps/desktop/README.zh.md#local-desktop-settings)统一说明字段和行为。

配置归属按运行依赖划分：由 Electron 负责且需要在 Host 启动前或不可用时读取配置的功能，使用壳层配置。Host 插件设置，包括 Web/Desktop 共用偏好，继续使用 Cordis。仅仅展示在 Desktop 中，不构成归属壳层的理由。统一设置界面可以使用不同的存储归属。

`desktop` 子目录集中存放壳层配置，不迁移已有文件。[快捷键决策](2026-09-20-device-local-shortcut-preferences.zh.md)继续负责 `userData/keybindings.json` 及其持久化语义。[共享 Web 应用决策](2026-09-10-desktop-web-wrapper.zh.md)仍约束 Host 组合和 profile 配置。
zh.alt:
**所有偏好都放入 Cordis。** 这需要可用的 Host。由 Electron 直接读取 `cordis.patch.yml` 会重复实现配置求值；单独的 patch 不包含插件默认值和其他配置层。

**迁移所有在 Desktop 展示的设置。** 界面位置不意味着需要独立于 Host。这会拆分 Web/Desktop 共用偏好，并让配置脱离实际使用它的插件。
zh.cs:
壳层与 Host 配置分别有自己的归属。每项设置需说明归属和生效时机。独立壳层配置支持更多不依赖 Host 的功能，但不引入第二套应用后端。

现有设置在功能调整或需要独立于 Host 使用时，可逐项评估。这是评估方向，不是已排期的迁移计划或预设清单。实际迁移需明确唯一配置来源、迁移已有值并定义生效时机，避免两套存储间存在含糊的优先级。共用的 Host 设置在归属要求不变时继续使用 Cordis。

en.t: Retained PTC processes follow file policy
en.p: Retaining JavaScript variables does not require broader file access. A process that outlives one execution can also outlive a one-time approval or a Session policy change. File-policy changes must invalidate retained environments and begin stopping their file handles and background work.
en.dc:
`persistent-in-memory` starts its Node process through the same sandbox provider as `per-call`. A retained owner uses one resolved mode, workspace root and Session identity until release. The [memory decision](2026-09-23-best-effort-persistent-ptc.md) owns retained values, failure recovery and package composition; this note owns file authority.

The [PTC-owned cleanup decision](2026-10-09-ptc-owned-policy-cleanup.md) supersedes this note’s permission-setter completion and cleanup-ownership decision. Permission changes commit synchronously; PTC owns immediate cancellation and waits internally before subsequent execution. The tools package keeps Agent ownership and omits the owner for temporary escalations.

An approved one-time escalation omits the state owner and receives a fresh temporary environment. Its process is released before the call returns. It cannot access standing variables, and its declarations do not survive. The standing environment keeps its original policy and variables. Nested tools continue to apply their own permissions and approvals.
en.alt:
**Unconfined retained execution.** Omitting confinement simplifies a temporary prototype but couples variable retention to full host file access. The existing process sandbox supports long-lived processes, so this grant is unnecessary.

**Changing the running process policy.** Existing backends apply restrictions at launch. Arbitrary retained objects, open handles and background work cannot be transferred into another policy with the existing interface. Releasing the environment prevents later evaluations from reusing those resources.

**Coordinating through permission presets.** File-policy changes also have direct callers. PTC observes committed Session mode events from both paths, independently of user-facing preset selection.

**Keeping an elevated environment.** A one-time approval cannot authorize future programs or idle background work. Omitting the state owner makes the approval lifetime explicit while preserving the standing environment.
en.cs: Normal calls retain variables without changing file permissions. Changing sandbox mode discards variables. Escalated programs must be self-contained. Runtime consumers must release a retained owner before supplying a different policy without a Session mode change; the provider rejects inconsistent reuse. The sandbox inherits the existing backends’ file-effect coverage and platform limitations.

zh.t: 保留状态的 PTC 进程遵循文件策略
zh.p: 保留 JavaScript 变量不需要更大的文件访问权限。跨调用存活的进程也可能在单次审批结束或 Session 策略变化后继续运行。文件策略变化必须使保留环境失效，并开始停止其文件句柄和后台工作。
zh.dc:
`persistent-in-memory` 与 `per-call` 通过同一个沙箱提供方启动 Node 进程。保留状态的所有者在释放前使用固定的已解析权限模式、工作区根目录和 Session 身份。[内存决策](2026-09-23-best-effort-persistent-ptc.zh.md)负责保留值、失败恢复和包组成；本文负责文件权限。

[PTC 自行等待清理的决策](2026-10-09-ptc-owned-policy-cleanup.zh.md)替代本文关于权限设置完成时点和清理归属的决策。权限变化同步提交；PTC 负责立即取消，并在后续执行前内部等待清理。工具包保留 Agent 所有权，在临时提权时省略所有者。

单次获准的提权省略状态所有者，使用全新的临时环境。该次调用返回前释放进程，无法访问原环境的变量，也不会保留新声明。原环境保持原权限和变量。嵌套工具继续应用各自的权限和审批规则。
zh.alt:
**不限制保留状态的执行环境。** 省略沙箱能简化临时原型，却把变量保留与完整宿主文件访问权限绑定。现有进程沙箱支持长期运行的进程，因此这项授权没有必要。

**修改运行中进程的策略。** 现有后端在启动时应用限制。现有接口无法把任意保留对象、打开的句柄和后台工作转移到另一策略。释放环境可以防止后续执行复用这些资源。

**通过权限预设协调清理。** 文件策略也有直接调用方。PTC 观察两类调用方提交的 Session 模式事件，无需依赖面向用户的预设选择。

**保留提权环境。** 单次审批不能授权未来程序或空闲期间的后台工作。省略状态所有者明确了审批生效的范围，同时保留原环境。
zh.cs: 普通调用保留变量，同时维持原文件权限。切换沙箱模式会丢弃变量。提权程序必须包含执行所需的完整代码。未发生 Session 模式变化时，运行时消费者在传入不同策略前必须释放保留状态的所有者；提供方拒绝策略不一致的复用。沙箱继承现有后端的文件约束范围与平台限制。

en.t: Claimed commands as atomic composer chips
en.p: The [Lexical composer decision](../../archived/architecture/2026-08-20-web-composer-lexical-editor.md) kept a claimed command as literal leading text. A TextNode transform styled the token and split typed overflow back out of it, and the submit machine held the claim while the draft string started with the token. Every edit at the token boundary ran through that transform. Lexical merges same-style neighbours before the overflow node's own transform runs, so the split and the merge looped until Lexical aborted the update with error #14 and the DOM diverged from the editor state (issue #4490). PR #5480 cleared the copied style for the reported gesture; pasting an image after a claim and IME composition reach the same transform and remained unverified. The plain-text reference entity also needed a precedence rule to leave the claimed token alone.
en.dc:
A claim replaces the leading trigger span with `CommandChipNode`, an atomic inline `DecoratorNode`, followed by the token's argument separator as an ordinary text node.

- The node carries the `CommandClaim`, including its submit closure. History restores nodes with their fields, so undoing a chip deletion restores the claim. JSON export writes the token text; JSON import yields a plain text node because the closure has no JSON form.
- The detect projection counts the chip as one U+FFFC, so trigger detection never re-reads the command name. The clipboard projection is the token without its separator. The chip is not a reference occurrence. `EditorProjection.command` is the claim of a chip that opens the document.
- Outside a submit transaction, the machine's claim follows the document: `draft-changed` carries the leading chip's claim, so deleting or displacing the chip releases the claim and a history restore re-enters claimed. A failed command submission settles to the same rule, so it returns to claimed exactly when a chip still leads; a claim adjudicated from typed text at Enter has no chip and returns to plain.
- Node transforms keep the chip on the leading seat. A chip with a preceding sibling or inside a later block becomes its literal token, which releases the claim as typing before the old token did. The chip's own transform sees sibling insertions and moves between blocks; a paragraph transform sees a block inserted before the chip's block, so no update walks the whole document.
- Deletion takes two steps. A character deletion that reaches the chip from a collapsed caret marks it selected (`data-selected` on its host; the root's `data-composer-chip-selected` hides the caret), and the next deletion in the same direction removes it whole. Deletions are decided both on the character-deletion command and on deletion input events, because iOS applies a ranged `deleteContentBackward` without that command. A key whose dispatch produced no character deletion, a click, blur, or a caret that leaves the chip clears the mark, so platform deletion shortcuts such as macOS Ctrl+H keep it. The editor selection stays a collapsed range and `isKeyboardSelectable()` stays false for the reason recorded on reference chips. Escape still does not release a claim.
- The persisted draft records the leading chip's claim token (`DraftSnapshot.command`), never the claim. On restore the input asks the trigger pipeline's `resolveClaim`, which polls the optional source hook `matchClaim`: it awaits the source's catalog and answers only a claim, never invoking or executing the command, unlike Enter's `matchEnter`. The chip is rebuilt only at the revision the restore produced and merged into the seed's history entry; an earlier edit, an unclaimed token, or a catalog failure keeps the literal token, which Enter still adjudicates.
- `claim-decor.ts` and the text-reference precedence rule are deleted.

The `slash/input-*` events, `CommandClaim`, `InputState.claim`, and trigger sources keep their fields. `CommandClaim.token` still ends with the separator, and command arguments are still read from the clipboard text after it.
en.alt:
**Keep literal text and repair each gesture.** Every gesture that reaches the boundary node needs its own proof, as #5480 showed, and the precedence rule with text references remains.

**Reuse `ReferenceChipNode`.** Reference chips are occurrences serialized through their owner codec at submit; a command is not model content and must not enter `occurrences`.

**Put the separator inside the chip text.** Lexical appends a managed line break after an inline decorator that ends its block, so the blank-arguments hint rendered by `p:last-child::after` would move to the next line. A separate text node keeps the hint on the chip's line.

**Select the chip with a NodeSelection.** The plain-text binding's arrow, typing, and deletion handlers ignore non-range selections, so each of those gestures would need its own handling at the chip.

**Keep claims in a shell map keyed by NodeKey.** The map duplicates the field the node already carries and needs pruning whenever history is cleared.
en.cs:
- Backspace no longer edits the command name character by character to reopen the menu. At the chip's edge, two Backspace or Delete presses remove the chip and leave the arguments as plain text.
- A reload restores the chip after the command catalog loads; until then, and when restoration does not apply, the draft shows the literal token.
- Whole-chip deletion through a real key event is observable only in the browser lane because jsdom lacks `Selection.modify`; `lifecycle-chrome.e2e.ts` pins the separator, select, and delete presses.

zh.t: 已认领命令作为输入框原子 chip
zh.p: [Lexical 输入框决策](../../archived/architecture/2026-08-20-web-composer-lexical-editor.md)把已认领命令保留为行首字面文本。一个 TextNode transform 给 token 加样式，并把输入进去的溢出文字拆出来；提交状态机在草稿字符串以 token 开头时保持认领。token 交界处的每次编辑都会经过这个 transform。Lexical 会在溢出节点自身的 transform 执行前合并样式相同的相邻节点，于是拆分与合并循环往复，直到 Lexical 以错误码 14 中止这次更新，DOM 与编辑器状态随之分叉（issue #4490）。PR #5480 针对报告的手势清除了被复制的样式；认领后粘贴图片和 IME 组字会进入同一个 transform，仍未验证。纯文本引用实体也需要一条优先级规则来避开已认领的 token。
zh.dc:
认领把行首触发区间替换为 `CommandChipNode`（一个原子 inline `DecoratorNode`），其后是作为普通文本节点的 token 参数分隔符。

- 节点携带 `CommandClaim`，包括其 submit 闭包。历史记录恢复节点时连同字段一起恢复，因此撤销 chip 删除会恢复认领。JSON 导出写入 token 文本；闭包没有 JSON 形式，因此 JSON 导入得到纯文本节点。
- 检测投影把 chip 计为一个 U+FFFC，触发检测不会再读到命令名。剪贴板投影是不含分隔符的 token。chip 不是引用 occurrence。`EditorProjection.command` 是位于文档开头的 chip 所携带的认领。
- 在提交事务之外，状态机的认领跟随文档：`draft-changed` 携带行首 chip 的认领，因此删除或挤开 chip 会释放认领，历史恢复会重新进入 claimed。命令提交失败后按同一规则结算，只要行首仍有 chip 就回到 claimed；Enter 时从输入文本裁决出的认领没有 chip，回到 plain。
- 节点 transform 让 chip 保持在行首位置。前面有兄弟节点或位于后续块中的 chip 会变回字面 token，并像在旧 token 前输入那样释放认领。chip 自身的 transform 覆盖兄弟节点插入和跨块移动；段落 transform 覆盖在 chip 所在块之前插入块的情况，因此没有任何更新需要遍历整个文档。
- 删除分两步。从折叠光标出发、方向触及 chip 的字符删除先把它标记为选中（宿主元素上的 `data-selected`；根元素的 `data-composer-chip-selected` 隐藏光标），同方向的下一次删除才整体移除它。字符删除命令和删除类输入事件都会参与判断，因为 iOS 处理带范围的 `deleteContentBackward` 时不经过该命令。分发过程中没有产生字符删除的按键、点击、失焦或光标离开 chip 会清除标记，因此 macOS Ctrl+H 这类平台删除快捷键会保留它。编辑器选区保持为折叠的 range，`isKeyboardSelectable()` 仍为 false，原因与引用 chip 记录的相同。Escape 仍不释放认领。
- 持久化的草稿记录行首 chip 的认领 token（`DraftSnapshot.command`），从不保存认领本身。恢复时输入框调用触发管线的 `resolveClaim`，它轮询可选的 source 钩子 `matchClaim`：等待 source 的目录就绪，只应答认领，与 Enter 的 `matchEnter` 不同，从不调用或执行命令。chip 只在恢复产生的那个版本上重建，并合入种子的历史条目；在此之前发生的编辑、无人认领的 token 或目录加载失败都会保留字面 token，Enter 仍会对其裁决。
- 删除 `claim-decor.ts` 和文本引用的优先级规则。

`slash/input-*` 事件、`CommandClaim`、`InputState.claim` 与触发源的字段保持不变。`CommandClaim.token` 仍以分隔符结尾，命令参数仍从其后的剪贴板文本读取。
zh.alt:
**保留字面文本并逐个修复手势。** 如 #5480 所示，每个触及交界节点的手势都需要单独证明，与文本引用之间的优先级规则也仍然存在。

**复用 `ReferenceChipNode`。** 引用 chip 是在提交时经 owner codec 序列化的 occurrence；命令不是模型内容，不能进入 `occurrences`。

**把分隔符放进 chip 文本。** inline decorator 位于块末尾时，Lexical 会在其后追加受管换行，由 `p:last-child::after` 渲染的空参数提示会移到下一行。独立的文本节点让提示留在 chip 所在行。

**用 NodeSelection 选中 chip。** 纯文本绑定的方向键、输入和删除处理器都会忽略非 range 选区，这些手势在 chip 处都需要单独处理。

**在 shell 中用按 NodeKey 索引的表保存认领。** 该表重复了节点已携带的字段，并且每次清空历史时都需要修剪。
zh.cs:
- Backspace 不再逐字编辑命令名并重新打开菜单。在 chip 边缘按两次 Backspace 或 Delete 会删除 chip，参数保留为普通文字。
- 刷新后，命令目录加载完成即恢复 chip；在此之前以及恢复不适用时，草稿显示字面 token。
- 通过真实按键整体删除 chip 只能在浏览器 lane 中观察，因为 jsdom 缺少 `Selection.modify`；`lifecycle-chrome.e2e.ts` 固定了删除分隔符、选中、删除这三次按键。

en.t: Shared native CUA process with Agent-scoped state
en.p: On macOS 26.6.2, replayd derives capture-client identity from the executable path. Two live helpers at the same path repeatedly replace each other's connections even when their screenshot requests are sequential. Byte-identical executables at distinct real paths complete sequential and concurrent captures; two symlinks to one executable reproduce the failure. A per-request lock cannot isolate retained system connections.
en.dc:
One user shares a native service per executable content digest across Agents and Hosts. A version lock elects the service; an additional canonical-executable-path lock prevents different builds published at one path from running together. Locks remain held until process exit. The managed startup command hands service lifetime to its client connections, and the last connection's completed cleanup ends the service. The diagnostic stdin/stdout entry proxies to this same service.

Each Agent connection owns its application handles, AX snapshots, limits and cancellation state. An app handle grants no exclusive use of the application. A FIFO orders complete desktop operations, including clipboard transactions, while response writes are independent. Agent disposal retires only its connection. The [object API decision](2026-09-17-experimental-cua-object-api.md) retains evaluator independence and coordinate semantics; the [consent decision](2026-09-26-cua-application-consent.md) retains application authorization.

Cancellation and timeout first stop one request and wait for acknowledgement. A timed-out screenshot retains the single system-RPC slot until the real callback completes; new screenshots fail with `CAPTURE_BUSY` instead of accumulating requests. Late pixels are discarded, while other AX and input operations remain available. Ending an await or creating a wrapper does not prove that the system connection has recovered. An operation or cleanup that cannot stop can invalidate the process, making every old handle unusable. Uncertain input is never replayed automatically.
en.alt: Separate executable copies per Agent avoid the observed identity collision but multiply system capture clients. One shared service preserves a single capture client while retaining Agent state isolation. An in-process Swift binding changes crash containment without removing the system RPC. The [continuous-hover decision](2026-10-13-cua-continuous-hover.md) keeps individual operations serialized without cross-call application ownership.
en.cs: Two Hosts can race to start the service and receive the same instance. A may retain its app object while B screenshots and changes the same application; A reads fresh AX afterward. An Agent closing cannot retire another Agent's handles. Recovery must distinguish request, snapshot, handle, capture-backend and process failure. A lost system callback occupies a bounded capture slot; reliable in-process backend reset requires separate platform evidence. The historical DeepSeek failures have matching RPC errors, but their competing-client identity was not recovered from retained logs.

zh.p: 在 macOS 26.6.2 上，replayd 按可执行文件路径生成捕获客户端标识。同一路径的两个活动 helper 即使依次截图，也会反复替换对方的连接。相同字节的可执行文件位于不同实际路径时，交替和并发截图均成功；两个符号链接指向同一文件仍会失败。逐请求加锁不能隔离仍存活的系统连接。
zh.dc:
同一用户的多个 Agent 和 Host 按可执行文件内容摘要共享原生服务。版本锁选出服务实例，规范化可执行路径上的另一把锁阻止发布在同一路径的不同构建同时运行。进程退出才释放锁。受管启动命令将服务生命期交给客户端连接，最后一条连接清理完成后服务退出。诊断用 stdin/stdout 入口也代理到同一个服务。

每条 Agent 连接独立持有应用句柄、AX 快照、资源限制和取消状态。持有 app 句柄不代表独占应用。FIFO 队列串行执行包含剪贴板事务的完整桌面操作，响应写入独立进行。Agent 销毁只释放自己的连接。[对象接口决策](2026-09-17-experimental-cua-object-api.zh.md)继续负责执行器独立性及坐标语义，[授权决策](2026-09-26-cua-application-consent.zh.md)继续负责应用许可。

取消或超时先停止单次请求并等待确认。截图超时后，唯一的系统 RPC 槽位保留到真实回调结束；新截图返回 `CAPTURE_BUSY`，不继续堆积请求。迟到图片被丢弃，其他 AX 与输入操作仍可执行。结束 await 或创建包装对象不能证明系统连接已恢复。操作或清理无法停止时，才可能使进程失效，届时所有旧句柄均不可用。结果不确定的输入不会自动重放。
zh.alt: 每个 Agent 使用独立的可执行文件副本可以避开已观察到的标识冲突，但会增加系统捕获客户端数量。共享服务保留一个捕获客户端，同时隔离 Agent 状态。进程内 Swift 绑定会改变崩溃隔离方式，不能消除系统 RPC。[连续悬停决策](2026-10-13-cua-continuous-hover.zh.md)保留单次操作串行执行，不分配跨调用的应用所有权。
zh.cs: 两个 Host 同时启动服务时可连接同一个实例。A 可以保留 app 对象，B 对同一应用截图并修改，之后 A 重新读取 AX。一个 Agent 关闭不会释放另一个 Agent 的句柄。恢复需要区分请求、快照、句柄、截图后端和进程失效。系统回调丢失会占用有界的捕获槽位，可靠的进程内后端重置需要另外取得平台验证。历史 DeepSeek 失败具有相同 RPC 错误，但保留日志未能确定当时另一个冲突客户端的身份。

en.t: Domain image Slots and a shared gallery Factory
en.p: User messages, assistant output, Trajectory records, and tool results need independently replaceable image presentation. Their official entries can share one gallery, but sharing that implementation must not merge their replacement positions or hide the caller's image-reading authority.
en.dc:
Each domain declares its own image Slot and supplies the framework's `renderSlot` seat to the component that renders it. The official attachment entries use one reusable Content Factory, following the [Body Slot and Content Factory division](2026-10-09-reasoning-content-slot-factory.md).

| Entry | Declaration owner and renderer |
| --- | --- |
| `conversation.chat.user.images` Slot | The `conversation.chat.user.content` Factory declares it; `UserContent` renders it for user messages, pending steering, and local echoes. |
| `conversation.chat.message.images` Slot | The Assistant node registration declares it; `AssistantMarkdown` renders consecutive output-image groups. |
| `conversation.trajectory.images` Slot | The Trajectory view registration declares it; record attachments and tool-output blocks render it through the ledger's Slot seat. |
| `tool.call.images` Slot | The `read_image` tool-view registration declares it; `ToolRow` renders the result image. |
| `conversation.images.content` Factory | The attachment plugin registers this root-scoped gallery, implemented by `MessageImagesContent`. |

The attachment plugin fills all four image Slots with the same `MessageImages` React adapter at priority 100. A smaller priority replaces only the selected domain's entry; disposing that replacement restores the official entry. Each adapter invokes `conversation.images.content` with explicit image references, `loadImage`, and layout parameters. The shared Factory neither declares the domain Slots nor selects a domain from a scene parameter.

The image callers use their declared Slot directly; no image-entry Factory exists solely to forward one Slot call. User text remains a separate shared `conversation.user.text` Factory with its own keyed node Slot, as specified by the [user-text decision](2026-10-10-user-text-json-nodes.md).

`AssistantNodeView` passes its Slot seat and `loadImage` to `AssistantMarkdown`. User wrappers pass the loader through `UserStyleBubble` to `UserContent`. Trajectory passes its Slot seat and loader through the ledger. These paths preserve component responsibilities, image order, and keys without custom ReactNode-producing image callbacks.

Conversation owns read authorization, per-Session URL caching, and cleanup. The shared gallery never searches for a global current Session: persistent reads use the loader supplied by the caller, while submission-echo previews retain their existing browser URLs. Gallery layout, retries, thumbnails, and lightbox behavior remain in the attachment package.

`ChatView` keeps the existing `MarkdownDelegateProvider` with its wrapped file opener, external-link action, and file-image capabilities. Native-image composition does not replace Markdown image handling or its failure feedback.

`MessageImagesContentInput` accepts optional complete `MessageImageLabels`. Supplied labels are used unchanged; when omitted, the Content Factory's locale seat supplies the default copy.
en.alt:
**One shared image Slot for every caller.** A replacement intended for one domain would also affect the others; shared implementation does not require shared replacement identity.

**Import the gallery component across feature packages.** This bypasses standard Slot replacement and the reusable Factory entry point.

**Pass custom image-rendering functions or supply the loader through a private Context.** Framework Slot seats already express rendering authority, while explicit loader props preserve the caller's Session authority.
en.cs: Independent Slots allow domain-specific presentation without copying the gallery. Domain callers must forward the framework Slot seat to their plain React descendants and must supply an authorized loader at each image call. A Factory and an ordinary Slot have different lifetimes and ownership; a reusable implementation does not own every position where it appears.

zh.t: 领域图片 Slot 与共享画廊 Factory
zh.p: 用户消息、助手输出、Trajectory 记录和工具结果需要可独立替换的图片展示。官方条目可以共享同一画廊，但共享实现不能合并各自的替换位置，也不能隐藏调用方的图片读取授权。
zh.dc:
各领域声明自己的图片 Slot，并把框架 `renderSlot` 席位交给实际渲染它的组件。官方附件条目复用一个 Content Factory，沿用 [Body Slot 与 Content Factory 的分工](2026-10-09-reasoning-content-slot-factory.zh.md)。

| 入口 | 声明所有者与渲染组件 |
| --- | --- |
| `conversation.chat.user.images` Slot | `conversation.chat.user.content` Factory 声明，由 `UserContent` 为用户消息、待处理 steering 和本地回显渲染。 |
| `conversation.chat.message.images` Slot | Assistant 节点注册声明，由 `AssistantMarkdown` 渲染连续的输出图片组。 |
| `conversation.trajectory.images` Slot | Trajectory 视图注册声明，记录附件及工具输出块通过账本的 Slot 席位渲染。 |
| `tool.call.images` Slot | `read_image` 工具视图注册声明，由 `ToolRow` 渲染结果图片。 |
| `conversation.images.content` Factory | 附件插件注册此 root 作用域画廊，由 `MessageImagesContent` 实现。 |

附件插件以优先级 100 为四个图片 Slot 填入同一个 `MessageImages` React 适配组件。较小的优先级只替换选定领域的条目；替换条目释放后恢复官方条目。适配组件显式向 `conversation.images.content` 传入图片引用、`loadImage` 和布局参数。共享 Factory 不声明各领域的 Slot，也不通过场景参数选择领域。

图片调用方直接使用其声明的 Slot，不设置仅转发一次 Slot 调用的图片入口 Factory。用户文本仍使用独立共享的 `conversation.user.text` Factory 及其 keyed 节点 Slot，详见[用户文本决策](2026-10-10-user-text-json-nodes.zh.md)。

`AssistantNodeView` 将 Slot 席位与 `loadImage` 传给 `AssistantMarkdown`。用户包装层通过 `UserStyleBubble` 将 loader 传给 `UserContent`。Trajectory 通过账本传递自己的 Slot 席位与 loader。这些路径保持组件职责、图片顺序和 key，不使用自制的 ReactNode 图片渲染回调。

Conversation 拥有读取授权、逐 Session URL 缓存与回收。共享画廊不查找全局当前 Session：持久图片使用调用方提供的 loader 读取，本地提交回显预览保留已有浏览器 URL。画廊布局、重试、缩略图和灯箱行为仍由附件包负责。

`ChatView` 保留既有 `MarkdownDelegateProvider` 及其包装后的文件打开动作、外链动作和文件图片能力。原生图片组合不替代 Markdown 图片处理及失败反馈。

`MessageImagesContentInput` 接受可选的完整 `MessageImageLabels`。提供 labels 时原样使用，省略时由 Content Factory 的 locale 席位提供默认文案。
zh.alt:
**所有调用方共用一个图片 Slot。** 面向某个领域的替换也会影响其他领域；共享实现不要求共享替换身份。

**跨功能包导入画廊组件。** 绕过标准 Slot 替换机制和可复用的 Factory 入口。

**传递自制图片渲染函数，或通过私有 Context 供应 loader。** 框架 Slot 席位已经表达渲染权限，显式 loader props 则保留调用方的 Session 授权。
zh.cs: 独立 Slot 支持各领域定制展示而无需复制画廊。领域调用方需要将框架 Slot 席位传给普通 React 后代组件，并在每次图片调用中提供授权 loader。Factory 与普通 Slot 的生命周期和所有权不同；可复用实现不拥有它出现的所有位置。

en.t: Peer-scoped connect handshake
en.p: Automatically subscribing automation clients to forwarded events lets method-only callers receive and answer human interactions. CLI and MCP callers need independent participation and cleanup without changing browser authentication or assigning per-browser identities.
en.dc:
Browsers retain their existing signed Cookie, root launch-token exchange, shared `connection.browserPeer` with owner principal and `interactions: 'answer'`, and recovery behavior. Only API callers create independent Peers through `GET /connect?token=<launch-token>&interactions=answer|none`. The endpoint is API-only, defaults to `none`, rejects invalid or repeated declarations with 400, and retains Host/Origin checks and token authentication. It returns 302 with the Remote Mux destination and an API Cookie.

### Admission and ownership

- Connect publishes the API Peer before returning. Its signed API Cookie carries the authority, Peer id, and issue/expiry interval; interaction participation belongs to the live Peer, not another credential field. Browser v1 Cookies remain valid and always select the shared Peer. API v2 Cookies select only an existing independent Peer.
- HTTP validates the Cookie and finds its Peer without waiting for a WebSocket. Connect, HTTP, and WebSocket require no cross-transport readiness ordering.
- One API lifecycle WebSocket owns the Peer. Duplicate attachment is refused; closure removes the Peer before asynchronous disposal completes. Later HTTP and reconnect attempts using that API Cookie are refused. A fresh connect is caller-owned.
- Already-admitted unary requests retain their request-level cancellation semantics. Closing the lifecycle socket does not cancel independent HTTP requests or accepted Session work.
- Browser sockets never own the shared Peer. Refresh, concurrent tabs, repeated launch-URL visits, and Host restart require no per-browser Peer restoration or credential reuse machinery.

### Accepted retention

An API caller may exit after connect without establishing its WebSocket. If it has performed no other work, its Peer retains only lightweight identity, scope, and registry state, not a socket, subscription, or background job. It may remain until Host shutdown. No initial-connect deadline, idle sweep, or in-memory expiry timer exists; Cookie expiration is checked on admission independently of record retention. Repeated abandoned connects accumulate lightweight records, an accepted cost for authenticated local callers. Actual operations still own cleanup of resources they acquire.

### Events and Client scope

The Client creates forwarded-event machinery only for `answer`. The Host checks `peer.signal.aborted` first, then `peer.interactions` at both `$events` and `$events/result`: `none` refuses both regardless of principal. An answering owner receives forwarded waterfalls and may reply only through the same Peer as the stream; an answering non-owner receives only RBAC-authorized broadcasts and cannot reply to waterfalls. Only active owner answering streams count as live answering clients. Browsers remain one shared answering party; distinguishing browser credentials from each other is deliberately unsupported.

Non-page Clients supply HTTP and WebSocket transports using the same API Cookie and Host base URL. Passive clients open their lifecycle socket independently of unary calls and may call generated raw stream methods. They do not use `$stream()`, the browser-generation recovery helper: it rejects immediately in `none` mode. Raw stream failure is terminal; the caller owns any new connect and retry. Existing answering-client generation behavior and Host fact delivery remain unchanged; there is no additional API recovery subsystem.
en.alt:
**Independent Peers for browsers too.** This adds credential identities, restart reconstruction, and repeated-login reuse to preserve tabs. Browser callers can remain one party, so the original browser model stays intact.

**Publish only after upgrade or require Mux readiness before unary.** Both reject or delay valid HTTP that arrives first. Connect is the publication point.

**Deadlines and pending/bound activation states.** They reclaim lightweight idle records at the cost of timers and transition races. Unused Peers may remain until shutdown.

**Adapt browser stream recovery to passive callers.** This spreads interaction mode into generation-aware stream consumers and their tests. Raw streams already support CLI/MCP calls; passive callers manage failure themselves.

**Client-only events switch or Host-global configuration.** Neither enforces independent participation. The authenticated Peer supplies the mode checked by the Host.
en.cs:
Unconnected API records need not be promptly reclaimed; resource-heavy additions to idle Peers require revisiting that choice. API Cookies cannot restore a Peer after its socket closes or the Host restarts. Browser Cookie format and authentication behavior remain unchanged, with no reauthentication migration. API and browser Cookies use the same authority-specific name, so API callers keep their own Cookie storage rather than exchanging credentials in a shared browser jar. Any launch-token holder may request `answer`; this is interaction participation, not user isolation.

The [duplex-stream decision](2026-09-19-remote-duplex-stream.md) retains Peer scopes and stream framing. The [browser authentication decision](2026-08-24-browser-token-authentication.md) retains browser token, signature, authority, and lifetime semantics; only independent API admission is added here. Both records remain active.

zh.t: 以 Peer 为作用域的建连握手
zh.p: 让自动化客户端自动订阅转发事件，会使只需调用方法的客户端也收到并回答人机交互。CLI 与 MCP 调用方需要独立参与和清理机制，而不改变浏览器认证或为每个浏览器赋予独立身份。
zh.dc:
浏览器保留现有签名 Cookie、根路径 launch token 交换、共享 `connection.browserPeer` 和恢复行为。只有 API 调用方通过 `GET /connect?token=<launch-token>&interactions=answer|none` 创建独立 Peer。该端点仅供 API 使用，默认 `none`，非法或重复声明返回 400，并保留 Host/Origin 检查和 token 认证。它返回 302、Remote Mux 目标地址和 API Cookie。

### 接纳与所有权

- Connect 在返回前发布 API Peer。签名 API Cookie 包含 authority、Peer 标识和签发／过期区间；交互参与模式属于有效 Peer，不再重复写入凭证字段。浏览器 v1 Cookie 保持有效，始终选择共享 Peer；API v2 Cookie 只选择已存在的独立 Peer。
- HTTP 校验 Cookie 并查找 Peer，不等待 WebSocket。Connect、HTTP 与 WebSocket 不要求跨传输的就绪顺序。
- 一条 API 生命周期 WebSocket 拥有 Peer。重复关联被拒绝；关闭时在异步释放完成前移除 Peer。之后使用该 API Cookie 的 HTTP 与重连请求被拒绝，调用方负责重新 connect。
- 已受理的 unary 请求保留请求级取消语义。生命周期连接关闭不会取消独立 HTTP 请求或已接受的 Session 工作。
- 浏览器 socket 不拥有共享 Peer。刷新、多标签页、重复打开启动 URL 和 Host 重启不需要每浏览器 Peer 的恢复或凭证复用机制。

### 接受的保留行为

API 调用方可能在 connect 后退出，始终没有建立 WebSocket。如果它没有执行其他工作，Peer 仅保留轻量身份、作用域与登记状态，不持有 socket、订阅或后台任务，可以保留到 Host 退出。不设置首次建联期限、空闲扫描或内存过期定时器；Cookie 过期在接纳时检查，与记录保留无关。反复放弃 connect 会累积轻量记录，这是已认证本地调用方场景下接受的成本。实际操作仍负责清理其获取的资源。

### 事件与 Client 范围

Client 仅在 `answer` 模式创建转发事件机制。Host 首先检查 `peer.signal.aborted`，随后在 `$events` 与 `$events/result` 两处检查 `peer.interactions`：无论 principal 是什么，`none` 都被拒绝。回答型 owner 收到转发的 waterfall，且只能从拥有事件流的同一 Peer 回答；回答型非 owner 仅收到经 RBAC 授权的广播，不能回答 waterfall。只有未取消的 owner 回答流计入在线回答客户端。浏览器仍是同一个共享回答方；本设计明确不区分不同浏览器凭证的身份。

非页面 Client 提供使用同一 API Cookie 与 Host 基址的 HTTP 和 WebSocket 传输。被动客户端独立于 unary 调用打开生命周期连接，也可以调用生成的原始流方法。它们不使用浏览器代际恢复辅助方法 `$stream()`：该方法在 `none` 模式立即拒绝。原始流失败直接结束；调用方负责重新 connect 和重试。既有回答型客户端的代际行为与 Host facts 下发不变，不另建 API 恢复系统。
zh.alt:
**也为浏览器创建独立 Peer。** 为保留多标签页行为，这需要凭证身份、重启重建和重复登录复用。浏览器调用方可以保持为同一方，因此保留原模型。

**升级后才发布，或在 unary 前等待 Mux 就绪。** 两者都会拒绝或延迟先到达的有效 HTTP。Connect 才是发布时机。

**建联期限和 pending/bound 激活状态。** 它们以定时器和状态转换竞争为代价回收轻量空闲记录。未使用的 Peer 可以留到退出。

**为被动调用方适配浏览器流恢复。** 这会把交互模式传入依赖代际的流消费者及其测试。原始流已支持 CLI/MCP 调用，被动调用方自行处理失败。

**仅客户端事件开关或 Host 全局配置。** 两者都不能强制独立参与规则。由已认证 Peer 提供 Host 检查的模式。
zh.cs:
未建联的 API 记录不要求及时回收；若为空闲 Peer 增加重资源，必须重新评估这一取舍。连接关闭或 Host 重启后，API Cookie 不能恢复 Peer。浏览器 Cookie 格式与认证行为保持不变，无需重新认证迁移。API 与浏览器 Cookie 使用同一 authority 专属名称，因此 API 调用方维护自己的 Cookie 存储，不在共享浏览器 Cookie jar 中交换凭证。任何 launch token 持有者都可以请求 `answer`；这是交互参与，不是用户隔离。

[双工流决策](2026-09-19-remote-duplex-stream.zh.md)继续定义 Peer 作用域和流帧格式。[浏览器认证决策](2026-08-24-browser-token-authentication.zh.md)保留浏览器 token、签名、authority 与有效期语义；本记录只增加独立 API 接纳。两份既有记录继续保留。

en.t: PTC owns policy-change cleanup waits
en.p: Stopping a retained Node process and its nested tools can take longer than recording a new file policy. Making permission setters await that cleanup spreads PTC lifecycle requirements into unrelated callers, including Webhook Session creation, and adds cancellation windows to those callers.
en.dc:
Permission setters commit synchronously. Success means the selected policy is recorded; it does not guarantee that operations admitted under the old policy have completely stopped. This replaces the completion requirement and cleanup ownership in the [retained-process sandbox decision](2026-10-08-persistent-ptc-sandbox.md), whose confinement and one-time escalation rules still apply.

PTC observes committed Session mode changes. The tool bridge immediately cancels affected complete calls, including pending approvals and nested tools. A later PTC call waits for canceled predecessors to settle before resolving the latest standing policy. The Node provider immediately invalidates affected processes, including idle environments, starts cleanup, and retains the cleanup Promise internally. A later program waits for that cleanup; failed cleanup remains retryable and prevents process reuse. Unchanged modes preserve environments. Tool-registry and provider unload remove their observers and await owned work.
en.alt:
**Wait in permission setters.** This provides a definite completion point for old-authority work, but no current permission consumer requires that guarantee. It introduces a general resource registry and asynchronous API migration for PTC-specific cleanup. The completion guarantee belongs to PTC execution and disposal instead.

**Clean up only on the next PTC call.** An idle environment can retain background work indefinitely when no further call occurs. Policy changes begin cancellation immediately; only waiting is deferred.

**Reconfigure an existing process.** The sandbox applies restrictions at launch. Open handles, retained objects and background work require releasing the old environment before another policy can execute there.
en.cs: Permission changes return without process-cleanup latency. Old operations may remain active while cancellation finishes, and cleanup failure does not roll back the recorded policy. Subsequent PTC execution waits for cleanup and uses the latest policy. Webhook creation keeps its synchronous permission step, so that step adds no cancellation window before prompt admission. Regression coverage holds cleanup with explicit barriers, changes policy again while a call waits, checks idle cancellation without another call, and verifies cleanup retry and owner unload.

zh.t: PTC 自行等待策略变化后的清理
zh.p: 停止保留的 Node 进程及其嵌套工具，可能比记录新文件策略耗时更长。让权限设置等待这些清理，会把 PTC 生命周期要求传给 Webhook Session 创建等无关调用方，并为这些调用方增加取消窗口。
zh.dc:
权限设置同步提交。成功表示所选策略已经记录，不保证按旧策略接纳的操作已完全停止。这替代[保留进程沙箱决策](2026-10-08-persistent-ptc-sandbox.zh.md)中的完成要求和清理归属；其中的沙箱限制与单次提权规则继续适用。

PTC 观察已提交的 Session 模式变化。工具桥接立即取消受影响的完整调用，包括等待中的审批和嵌套工具。后续 PTC 调用先等待已取消的调用结束，再解析最新常设策略。Node 提供方立即使受影响的进程失效，包括空闲环境，开始清理并在内部保留清理 Promise。后续程序等待清理完成；清理失败可重试，且阻止复用进程。模式不变时保留环境。工具注册表和提供方卸载时移除各自监听器，并等待所拥有的工作结束。
zh.alt:
**在权限设置中等待。** 这可以明确旧权限下的工作完成时点，但当前权限调用方不需要该保证。为此增加通用资源登记和异步 API 迁移，会扩大 PTC 清理的影响范围。完成保证由 PTC 执行和销毁负责。

**等下次 PTC 调用再清理。** 没有后续调用时，空闲环境的后台工作可能一直存在。策略变化立即开始取消，只有等待被推迟。

**重新配置已有进程。** 沙箱在启动时应用限制。打开的句柄、保留对象和后台工作要求先释放旧环境，才能在其中按另一策略执行。
zh.cs: 权限变化返回时无需等待进程清理。取消完成前，旧操作可能仍在运行；清理失败不会回滚已记录的策略。后续 PTC 执行等待清理并使用最新策略。Webhook 创建保留同步权限步骤，该步骤不会在提交任务前增加取消窗口。回归测试通过显式信号阻塞清理，覆盖等待期间再次改变策略、没有后续调用时取消空闲环境、清理重试及所有者卸载。

en.t: Standard reasoning Body Slot and reusable Content Factory
en.p:
Reasoning bodies need to let third parties replace or wrap their presentation while reusing the official Markdown renderer, localized labels, and compact typography. An optional renderer parameter that makes the host choose between direct rendering and a chain fallback leaves the default body outside the registration system and forces plugins to maintain another Markdown call.

The render position and the base implementation serve different purposes: the position accepts plugin registrations and lets the framework select one, while any component can call the implementation directly. Calling the base implementation must not repeat plugin selection for that position or require a Session.
en.dc:
The design uses existing [Component Factories](2026-09-10-component-factories-and-local-slots.md) and ordinary Slots without adding framework dispatch machinery. | Name | Type | Owner and responsibility | | --- | --- | --- | | `conversation.chat.reasoning.body` | `single`, `session` Slot | Body position declared by the Assistant node registration; receives only original text and streaming state when expanded. | | `conversation.chat.reasoning.content` | `root` Factory | Standard reasoning content provided by `ui-chat`; accepts text, streaming state, and optional labels, supplies default labels, and fixes `variant="compact"`. | The Factory receives no Session identity, reads no Session, and owns no translation state. The current Factory API requires `scope`; `root` expresses the absence of a Session dependency, while each render position still has an independent React instance. The Chat plugin registers the Factory independently of any Body occupant, so replacing a body does not remove the base implementation. ### Registration and rendering 1. `ui-chat` registers the Content Factory with component props derived through `FactoryComponentPropsOf`. When the caller omits labels, the Factory constructs stable defaults from Chat's locale seat. 2. The Assistant node registration declares the Body Slot. An expanded `ReasoningRow` only calls `renderSlot`; it accepts no optional renderer, supplies no inline fallback, and does not check whether a plugin is enabled. 3. The official default Body is an ordinary registration with `priority: 100`. It forwards only `text` and `running` to the Content Factory. 4. Third parties wait for the Body declaration through `slots.inject` and register their Body with a smaller priority value. They may call the Content Factory directly and add their own controls around it without importing private official React components. 5. When a third party unregisters, the framework selects the official default registration again. Multiple third-party registrations follow existing single-slot priorities; they do not form middleware or render multiple bodies together. ```text ReasoningRow └─ conversation.chat.reasoning.body ├─ 官方默认 Body ───────────┐ └─ 第三方 Body → 自有控件 ─┤ └─ conversation.chat.reasoning.content └─ MarkdownText ``` The body render position: ```tsx ignore-check
{renderSlot('conversation.chat.reasoning.body', { text, running })}
``` The default Body and third-party wrappers use the same reusable implementation; a third party passes labels when it needs custom copy: ```tsx ignore-check renderFactorySlot('conversation.chat.reasoning.content', { text: displayText, running, labels, }) ``` ### Data, state, and lifecycle - `ReasoningBodyOwnerProps` contains only readonly `text: string` and `running: boolean`. `ReasoningContentInput` also accepts `labels?: MarkdownLabels`; supplied labels are used unchanged without field-level merging, and omission selects the official defaults. Callers own the localization and reference stability of custom labels. - The Body's `text` is always the original reasoning. A third party selects original or derived display text and passes that value to the Factory without rewriting the Session or Chat projection. - `ReasoningRow` retains its existing disclosure state, summary, shimmer, and title behavior. Plugin-specific selection state, buttons, and styles stay inside the plugin's Body wrapper; the official implementation supplies no `setHeaderAction`, header-action type, or corresponding state. - Registrations follow Cordis effect lifetimes. Collapsing the Body declaration removes its contributions through `slots.inject`; unloading the Chat plugin removes the Content Factory. - Factory components and the default Body have stable module-level identities. Text changes update props instead of rebuilding component types or keys. Plugin replacement or HMR may remount components according to existing framework semantics; unmounted components have no state-retention guarantee. ### Translation plugin integration The [anonymous translation design](2026-10-05-anonymous-reasoning-translation.md) retains its external-request, privacy, failure, and cancellation decisions; this design supersedes its body composition mechanism. The translation plugin registers in the standard Body Slot, renders original/translation selection, status, and retry controls in its own toolbar, and wraps the official Content Factory with its own state and optional custom labels rather than calling `MarkdownText` directly. Translation requests, splitting, caching, persistence, and settings remain unchanged. The translation toggle belongs to the plugin body rather than the official Think title. The design adds no Slot outside the body, does not handle user-message masking, and does not change the general Markdown parser.
en.alt:
**Translation-specific chain and host fallback.** The default content is not an ordinary registration, the host maintains a second render path, and third parties cannot directly reuse the complete official body implementation.

**Expose only the Body Slot.** This permits replacement, but wrapping plugins still have to copy the official Markdown call, labels, and variant.

**Provide only the Content Factory.** This permits implementation reuse but supplies no actual body position for third-party replacement registrations.

**Export React components across plugins.** This bypasses existing Factory loading, lifecycle, and type derivation and adds feature-plugin runtime dependencies.

**Name the Factory as general Markdown.** This implementation fixes reasoning-specific compact typography and supplies Chat defaults; it is not a general entry point for all Markdown uses.

**Make the official implementation maintain plugin header actions.** The default body has no such requirement; a dedicated setter makes the host own plugin state, cleanup, and button styles.

**Force official labels in the Factory.** Default copy must not prevent caller customization; an optional parameter provides an override without replacing the whole body implementation.
en.cs:
The old Slot name, chain-selector registrations, and header-action callback are unsupported, so third parties must migrate. Test fixtures and the Client inspect catalog must follow the new declarations rather than offer obsolete registration examples.

The Body remains an exclusive replacement position. This design does not automatically compose multiple text-transformation plugins or turn display transformations into redaction or model-input modification.

zh.t: 思考正文的标准 Slot 与可复用 Content Factory
zh.p:
思考正文需要允许第三方替换或包装展示，同时复用官方的 Markdown、本地化文案和紧凑排版。将扩展做成可选的 renderer 参数，再由宿主选择直接渲染或 chain fallback，会让默认正文存在于注册体系之外，插件也只能另行维护 Markdown 调用。

渲染位置与基础实现是两种不同的能力：位置允许多个插件注册并由框架选中一个，实现则应允许任何组件直接调用。调用基础实现不应再次触发该位置的插件选择，也不应要求 Session。
zh.dc:
沿用现有 [Component Factory](2026-09-10-component-factories-and-local-slots.zh.md) 和普通 Slot，不增加框架分发机制。 | 名称 | 类型 | 所有者与职责 | | --- | --- | --- | | `conversation.chat.reasoning.body` | `single`、`session` Slot | Assistant 节点注册声明的正文位置；展开时只接收原始文本与流式状态。 | | `conversation.chat.reasoning.content` | `root` Factory | `ui-chat` 提供的标准思考正文；接收文本、流式状态及可选 labels，提供默认文案并固定 `variant="compact"`。 | Factory 不接收 Session 身份，不读取 Session，不持有翻译状态。现有 Factory API 要求填写 `scope`，使用 `root` 表达无 Session 依赖；每个调用位置仍有独立的 React 实例。Factory 由 Chat 插件注册，而非依附于某个 Body occupant，第三方替换正文不会撤掉基础实现。 ### 注册与调用 1. `ui-chat` 注册 Content Factory，组件 props 由 `FactoryComponentPropsOf` 推导。调用者未传 labels 时，Factory 使用 Chat 的 locale seat 构造稳定的默认文案。 2. Assistant 节点注册声明 Body Slot。`ReasoningRow` 展开时只调用 `renderSlot`，不接收可选 renderer，不提供内联 fallback，也不判断插件是否启用。 3. 官方以 `priority: 100` 注册普通默认 Body。该组件只将 `text`、`running` 传给 Content Factory。 4. 第三方通过 `slots.inject` 等待 Body 声明，以较小的 priority 注册自己的 Body。第三方可直接调用 Content Factory，并在外层增加自己的控件；无需导入官方私有 React 组件。 5. 第三方注销后，框架重新选中官方默认注册项。多个第三方注册遵循现有 single 优先级，不形成 middleware，也不同时渲染多份正文。 ```text ReasoningRow └─ conversation.chat.reasoning.body ├─ 官方默认 Body ───────────┐ └─ 第三方 Body → 自有控件 ─┤ └─ conversation.chat.reasoning.content └─ MarkdownText ``` 正文调用位置： ```tsx ignore-check
{renderSlot('conversation.chat.reasoning.body', { text, running })}
``` 默认 Body 与第三方包装都使用同一个可复用实现；第三方需要自定义文案时传入 labels： ```tsx ignore-check renderFactorySlot('conversation.chat.reasoning.content', { text: displayText, running, labels, }) ``` ### 数据、状态与生命周期 - `ReasoningBodyOwnerProps` 仅包含只读的 `text: string` 与 `running: boolean`。`ReasoningContentInput` 另外允许 `labels?: MarkdownLabels`；传入的文案原样使用，不做字段级合并，省略时才使用官方默认文案。调用者负责自定义文案的本地化与引用稳定性。 - Body 的 `text` 始终是原始思考。第三方选择原文或派生显示文本后，只将该值交给 Factory，不改写 Session 或 Chat projection。 - 折叠状态、摘要、流光和标题由 `ReasoningRow` 保持现有行为。插件自己的切换状态、按钮及样式留在其 Body 包装中；官方不提供 `setHeaderAction`、标题动作类型或相应状态。 - 注册沿用 Cordis effect 生命周期。Body 声明撤销时，其贡献随 `slots.inject` 清理；Content Factory 在 Chat 插件卸载时撤销。 - Factory 组件与默认 Body 使用模块级稳定身份，文本变化作为 props 更新，不以文本重建组件类型或 key。插件替换或 HMR 可按现有框架语义重新挂载，不承诺保留被卸载组件的本地状态。 ### 翻译插件接入 [免登录翻译设计](2026-10-05-anonymous-reasoning-translation.zh.md)保留外部请求、隐私、失败与取消决策；其正文组合方式由本方案取代。翻译插件注册到标准 Body Slot，在自己的工具栏内渲染原文／译文切换、状态及重试按钮，使用自己的状态和可选自定义 labels 包装官方 Content Factory，不直接调用 `MarkdownText`。 翻译请求、分片、缓存、持久化和设置保持不变。翻译切换按钮属于插件正文，不再由官方思考标题承载；不增加正文外的 Slot，不处理用户消息遮挡，也不改动通用 Markdown 解析器。
zh.alt:
**翻译专用 chain 与宿主 fallback。** 默认内容不是普通注册项，宿主需要维护第二条渲染路径，第三方无法直接复用完整的官方正文实现。

**只开放 Body Slot。** 可以替换正文，但第三方包装时仍需复制官方 Markdown 调用、labels 与 variant。

**只提供 Content Factory。** 可以复用实现，但缺少允许第三方注册替换的实际正文位置。

**跨插件导出 React 组件。** 绕过现有 Factory 的加载、生命周期与类型推导，增加 feature-plugin 运行时依赖。

**将 Factory 命名为通用 Markdown。** 该实现固定思考正文的紧凑排版，并提供 Chat 默认文案，不是所有 Markdown 场景的通用入口。

**官方替插件维护标题动作。** 官方默认正文没有该需求；保留专用 setter 会让宿主承担插件的状态、清理与按钮样式。

**Factory 强制使用官方 labels。** 默认文案不应阻止调用者定制；可选参数即可表达覆盖，无需替换整套正文实现。
zh.cs:
旧 Slot 名称、chain selector 注册及标题动作回调不再受支持，第三方需要迁移。测试夹具与 Client inspect catalog 必须同步到新声明，避免仍向插件开发者提供旧注册方式。

Body 仍是独占替换位置。此方案不解决多个正文转换插件的自动组合，也不将显示变换提升为脱敏或模型输入修改能力。

en.t: Stored credentials take precedence over the launch environment
en.p: [Configuration source ownership](2026-08-04-configuration-source-ownership.md) ranked the inherited process environment above `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, and `credentials-local` refused `set` and `unset` for a name the launching shell exported. Two kinds of stored credential then had opposite precedence. pi-ai's resolvers read the credential record stored under `llm-pi-ai/<provider>` before any environment variable, so a stored OAuth grant or `api-key` record won over an exported key. A key that the Models page stored under a reference lost to the same exported name. Which credential a request used therefore depended on the provider family, and the Models page disabled its key field whenever the name was exported (#5527).
en.dc:
**A stored credential wins for every provider.** `LocalCredentialProvider` resolves a reference in this order:

```text
$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml        (provider-managed, written by set/unset)
> inherited process environment    (fallback; the provider never writes it)
> <invocation cwd>/.env            (fallback; the provider never writes it)
> $DSH_HOME/.env                   (fallback; the provider never writes it)
```

A save always writes the winning layer, so `describe` reports `writable: true` for every reference, and `set` and `unset` never refuse a name because it is exported. `resolve` and `describe` still report the supplying layer as `source` (`file`, `env`, `project-env`, or `user-env`). `authContextFrom` in `llm-pi-ai` answers pi-ai's `env()` from the credential seam before the launch environment, so a pi-ai resolver reads its stored record first, then a stored reference, then the fallbacks in the order above.

The non-secret ordering and the environment restrictions in configuration source ownership are unchanged. This note supersedes only its credential ordering.
en.alt:
**Keep the launch environment on top.** It keeps per-run overrides without touching the store, but it keeps the opposite precedence of stored records and stored references, and the Models page cannot save or replace a key while the launching shell exports the name.

**Refuse a write while only the launch environment supplies the name.** Under the new order such a write takes effect, because the stored value outranks the environment. Refusing it would block the first save of a key for every exported name, and it would keep the read-only field state that the new order removes.

**Warn when a stored value hides an exported variable.** The provider would compare layers on every resolution and report the result for users who keep both values on purpose, such as a shell profile that exports a key for other tools. The Models page help text states the order, and `describe` reports the supplying layer.
en.cs:
- A key left in `.credentials.yaml` overrides an exported variable with the same name, including a CI secret on a machine whose harness home stores a value for that name. The [upgrade guide](../../../../docs/upgrade-guide/v0.2.1-alpha.2/stored-credentials-precedence/guide.md) tells affected users how to keep the exported account.
- The Models page can always save, replace, or remove a key, and it does not disable the key field for an exported name.
- There is no per-run flag above the store. A one-run override takes a separate `DSH_HOME`.
- `packages/credentials/credentials-local/tests/local.spec.ts` covers a store over a launch environment value and its return after `unset`; `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/auth.spec.ts` covers a stored credential that wins over every launch layer.

zh.t: 存储的凭据优先于启动环境
zh.p: [配置来源所有权](2026-08-04-configuration-source-ownership.zh.md) 把继承的进程环境排在 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` 之前，并且 `credentials-local` 会拒绝对启动 shell 已导出的名字执行 `set` 和 `unset`。于是两类存储的凭据具有相反的优先级。pi-ai 的解析器先读取存储在 `llm-pi-ai/<provider>` 下的凭据记录，再读取任何环境变量，因此存储的 OAuth 授权或 `api-key` 记录会压过导出的密钥；而 Models 页面以引用形式存储的密钥会输给同名的导出变量。一次请求使用哪个凭据因此取决于提供方类别，而且只要该名字被导出，Models 页面就会禁用其密钥输入框（#5527）。
zh.dc:
**存储的凭据对每个提供方都优先。** `LocalCredentialProvider` 按以下顺序解析引用：

```text
$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml        (provider-managed, written by set/unset)
> inherited process environment    (fallback; the provider never writes it)
> <invocation cwd>/.env            (fallback; the provider never writes it)
> $DSH_HOME/.env                   (fallback; the provider never writes it)
```

保存总是写入胜出的那一层，因此 `describe` 对每个引用都报告 `writable: true`，`set` 与 `unset` 也不会因为名字已被导出而拒绝。`resolve` 与 `describe` 仍以 `source`（`file`、`env`、`project-env` 或 `user-env`）报告提供值的层。`llm-pi-ai` 中的 `authContextFrom` 先从凭据 seam、再从启动环境回答 pi-ai 的 `env()`，因此 pi-ai 解析器依次读取其存储的记录、存储的引用，再按上面的顺序读取后备来源。

配置来源所有权中的非秘密顺序与环境限制保持不变。本 Note 只替代其中的凭据优先级。
zh.alt:
**保持启动环境在最上层。** 它无需改动存储就能保留按次覆盖，但会保留存储记录与存储引用之间相反的优先级，而且只要启动 shell 导出了该名字，Models 页面就无法保存或替换密钥。

**只有启动环境提供该名字时拒绝写入。** 在新顺序下这样的写入会生效，因为存储值优先于环境。拒绝它会阻止为每个已导出的名字首次保存密钥，也会保留新顺序已经去掉的只读输入框状态。

**存储值遮蔽导出变量时发出警告。** 提供方需要在每次解析时比较各层，并向有意同时保留两个值的用户报告结果，例如在 shell 配置文件中为其他工具导出密钥的用户。Models 页面的帮助文本说明了该顺序，`describe` 也会报告提供值的层。
zh.cs:
- 留在 `.credentials.yaml` 中的密钥会覆盖同名的导出变量，包括在 harness home 存有该名字的机器上运行的 CI 机密。[升级指南](../../../../docs/upgrade-guide/v0.2.1-alpha.2/stored-credentials-precedence/guide.zh.md)说明受影响的用户如何继续使用导出的账户。
- Models 页面总能保存、替换或删除密钥，也不会因名字被导出而禁用密钥输入框。
- 存储之上没有按次生效的标志。一次运行的覆盖需要使用单独的 `DSH_HOME`。
- `packages/credentials/credentials-local/tests/local.spec.ts` 覆盖在启动环境值之上存储、以及 `unset` 后恢复该值；`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/auth.spec.ts` 覆盖存储的凭据压过每个启动层。

en.t: User-text candidate scheduling and Facts-driven refresh
en.p: User text contains references owned by independent businesses. Recognition must follow original-text positions, resolve collisions deterministically, and reuse unaffected matching work when Facts change. The evaluator must expose its scheduling behavior to pure logic tests without depending on React, browser timing, or elapsed-time benchmarks.
en.dc:
The composition is business registration, lazy candidate matching, a single reconciliation loop, readonly JSON nodes, and business-owned keyed renderers. Initialization and Facts refresh use the same algorithm; they differ only in which query caches remain valid.

### Rule roles and original coordinates

Every rule provides an ID, finite order, and synchronous `match(text, from, context)`. Each call returns its nearest eligible node with `start >= from`, or no candidate anywhere in the remaining original text. It returns one node, not all matches or a replacement document. The original string and UTF-16 offsets remain intact: a search cursor does not create a new word, line, or quoted-token boundary. Matching depends only on original text and Facts, not previously selected node payloads.

Each matcher resolves its own alternative spellings by earliest start and then its documented same-start choice; Session labels choose the longer match. A matcher cannot replace a consumed prefix with the remainder of an overlapping candidate. Each business owns its grammar, payload, and renderer; the generic evaluator has no Session, file, skill, or command branches.

There is one rule type and one candidate protocol. A candidate contains either a business node using the rule ID or a Text node preserving the original substring with an optional `data.display`. Text-producing rules compete by the same start, order, and stable ID as business rules. Order only breaks same-start ties; no rule gets precedence over an earlier position.

### One reconciliation loop

The evaluator keeps original text, the previous successful segmentation, registered definitions, per-rule Facts reads, and query results. Nonempty text initially has one Text covering `[0, text.length)`; empty text has no nodes. Initialization makes every rule invalid, including rules that read no Facts.

Each reconciliation starts its result cursor at zero. Every matcher obtains one candidate through the same cache-aware query operation. The evaluator selects the smallest candidate start, breaks same-start ties by ascending rule order and stable ID, emits the preceding raw Text gap, emits the winner, and advances the cursor to the winner's end. No candidate means the remaining raw text is emitted and recognition ends.

Only a consumed candidate or a candidate whose start is before the new cursor needs another query. A cached candidate beginning at or after the cursor remains eligible. A no-candidate result remains eligible as the cursor advances. All ranges are nonempty half-open original-text ranges; candidates cannot move the cursor backward or exceed the original string.

Previously accepted nodes are reusable output, not a complete list of possible matches: a losing candidate can become visible when an earlier winner disappears. The evaluator retains queries for this purpose instead of treating an old Text node or the absence of a business node as unconditional evidence of no match.

### Query cache and traversal

A query record contains its original `from` offset and either the next candidate, no candidate, or a failure. If a query from `q` returned a candidate starting at `s`, its result is valid for any requested cursor `c` with `q <= c <= s`. A no-candidate result is valid for every `c >= q`. Neither result proves anything before `q`. A failed query is reusable only at the same requested offset while its dependencies remain valid.

During a reconciliation, each matcher has one active candidate. The evaluator also retains the sorted query records already produced for that matcher across reconciliations; it does not enumerate all possible matches eagerly. Forward cursors walk these records monotonically. Queries generated in newly exposed gaps are merged with retained records in source order, with one record per query offset. Unsearched intervals require matching rather than an invented negative result.

The result cursor and matcher search cursors are distinct. Starting result reconciliation at zero does not require unchanged matchers to scan from zero again: their recorded queries answer valid requests. Each matcher must implement a forward search rather than repeatedly materializing every match in the remaining text. Internal scans, candidate selection, and result comparison still have costs; the scheduling guarantees concern actual matcher calls, not a claim that arbitrary regular expressions are linear.

### Actual Facts dependencies

`context.read(key)` returns the borrowed readonly value from the current Facts snapshot and records the read, including `undefined`. The reader is valid only during its owning synchronous call and cannot be retained. Businesses receive neither a whole Facts object, a manual `dependsOn` list, nor previous-output/cache objects.

A matcher's dependency set is the union of reads for the queries retained in its current cache generation, including losing candidates, no-match queries, and failed calls. Changed fields are detected with `Object.is` at field granularity. A new outer Facts object alone does not invalidate matching. When a rule is invalidated, its old queries and read set are discarded; subsequent calls establish the replacement read set, so obsolete conditional dependencies do not remain permanently attached.

Text-producing rules use the same query cache and dependency generation as every other rule. Updating a whitespace switch invalidates only its readers; it does not trigger an unconditional pass over the completed nodes.

### Facts, text, and registration refresh

A Facts update invalidates only rules that read changed fields. Their first query starts at original offset zero; all other rules retain their query records. The same reconciliation loop then compares fresh candidates with reusable ones. Refreshing a rule does not give it priority, and a new first candidate does not hide the removal of an earlier old winner.

A fresh candidate confined to previously plain text can split that Text without invoking unrelated matchers whose cached queries still cover the new cursors. A fresh candidate that loses to an earlier unchanged winner is discarded without invalidating that winner. When a fresh winner covers another candidate, only expired heads advance. When a winner disappears or shrinks, cached losing candidates can compete again; any previously unsearched interval causes a query at the newly exposed cursor. All changes use the same cursor loop and query-coverage rules.

Several changed Facts fields form one snapshot and one invalidation set. All affected matchers participate in the same reconciliation; one update is not committed before processing the next. Equivalent refreshed results reuse previous nodes and, when all elements remain identical, the entire result array. Reconciliation settles the complete document before publishing its result.

Original-text changes discard all query caches and supply one full-range Text as the previous segmentation. New or replaced rule definitions start with empty caches; unchanged definitions retain their independent queries. Removed rules lose their dependencies and candidates. Reconciliation after additions, removals, or order changes uses the same selection logic and can expose formerly blocked candidates.

### Output, ownership, and publication

Nodes retain `{ id, start, end, data }`. Business nodes use their matcher's ID; Text retains the exact source substring in `data.text` and optional display text in `data.display`. Output is ordered, nonoverlapping, and completely covers the original text. JSON compatibility and readonly ownership are TypeScript obligations: the evaluator neither freezes borrowed objects nor deep-copies Facts or payloads for isolation.

The document evaluator owns all caches; the registry retains neither evaluators nor document subscriptions. Separate text instances do not share state through a global cache. Only fully successful evaluation publishes a new result. A matcher failure carries the rule ID and cause and publishes no partial segmentation; its actual reads remain available for dependency-driven retry. Reentrant evaluation and escaped synchronous read contexts are rejected.

`conversation.user.text` remains a session-scoped Factory owning `conversation.user.text.node`, a keyed inline Slot. React consumes final nodes and forwards `raw` and `interactive` to the business renderer. Session, skill, file/folder, and command matching remain owned by their respective plugins, and actions remain in each renderer's Injection. No matching work or cache subscription moves into React.

`collapseWhitespace` and `trimWhitespace` each control one ordinary matcher and default to off. Collapse offers whitespace runs as Text candidates with display `" "`; trim offers original leading/trailing whitespace runs with display `""`. Trim has lower order than collapse, so it wins their same-start edge collisions. An earlier reference candidate consumes its whole range and naturally excludes internal whitespace candidates. Every Text candidate retains its exact raw substring; emoji and spaces between references remain intact. `interactive` and CSS `ellipsis` remain React Props, not matching Facts. Queue uses full original text with CSS ellipsis; native attachments remain in their existing cards and image Slots, outside text recognition.
en.alt: **Ordered whole-document business transforms.** A business can consume later text before an earlier reference from another business is considered, so fixed type order does not express leftmost recognition.
en.cs: Field-level invalidation can require a matcher to traverse the document again; it does not promise per-element Facts invalidation. Query history consumes memory proportional to the distinct recorded search positions for the current text and definitions. Reconciliation and JSON identity alignment can still traverse output without invoking matchers. The performance evidence is the exact scheduling count and query offsets, while semantic evidence compares refreshed output with a fresh evaluator. This mechanism requires no browser end-to-end or elapsed-time benchmark tests.

zh.t: 用户文本候选调度与 Facts 驱动刷新
zh.p: 用户文本包含独立业务拥有的引用。识别必须按原文位置推进，确定性地处理冲突，并在 Facts 变化时复用无关匹配工作。计算器必须能通过纯逻辑测试展示调度行为，不依赖 React、浏览器时序或耗时基准。
zh.dc:
采用业务注册、按需候选匹配、单一协调循环、只读 JSON 节点和业务拥有的 keyed renderer。初始化与 Facts 刷新使用同一个算法，只在查询缓存的有效性上存在差别。

### 规则职责与原始坐标

所有规则都提供 ID、有限的 order 和同步 `match(text, from, context)`。每次调用返回 `start >= from` 的最近有效节点，或确认剩余原文中没有候选。它返回一个节点，不返回全部匹配或整份替换文档。原始字符串及 UTF-16 坐标保持不变：搜索游标不创造新的词首、行首或带引号词元边界。匹配只依赖原文和 Facts，不依赖先前选中节点的 payload。

每个匹配器先按最早起点处理自身不同写法，再按该语法规定处理同起点选择；Session 标签选择较长匹配。匹配器不能把被消费前缀之后的半截重叠候选变成新匹配。语法、payload 和 renderer 均归对应业务所有，通用计算器不包含 Session、文件、skill 或命令分支。

只有一种规则类型和一个候选协议。候选既可以包含使用规则 ID 的业务节点，也可以包含保留原文子串、携带可选 `data.display` 的 Text 节点。产生 Text 的规则与业务规则按相同的起点、order 和稳定 ID 竞争。Order 仅裁定同起点冲突，任何规则都不优先于更早的位置。

### 单一协调循环

计算器保留原文、上一次成功分段、注册定义、逐规则 Facts 读取记录和查询结果。非空原文最初对应一个覆盖 `[0, text.length)` 的 Text，空原文没有节点。初始化使所有规则失效，包括不读取 Facts 的规则。

每次协调都从结果游标零开始，各匹配器通过同一个带缓存的查询操作获取一个候选。计算器选择起点最小的候选，同起点按规则 order 升序和稳定 ID 裁定，输出前面的原文 Text 空隙，输出赢家，再将游标推进到赢家末尾。全部没有候选时，输出剩余原文并结束识别。

只有被消费的候选或起点早于新游标的候选需要再次查询。缓存候选从新游标或其后开始时仍然有效；无候选结论在游标前进时保持有效。所有范围均是原文中的非空半开区间；候选不能使游标倒退或超出原文。

先前采纳的节点是可复用输出，不是所有可能匹配的完整清单；更早的赢家消失后，落败候选可能重新可见。计算器为此保留查询，而不能将旧 Text 节点或缺少某类业务节点无条件解释为没有匹配。

### 查询缓存与遍历

查询记录包含原始 `from` 偏移，以及下一个候选、无候选或失败。若从 `q` 查询得到起点为 `s` 的候选，则在请求游标 `c` 满足 `q <= c <= s` 时可以复用；无候选结论可用于所有 `c >= q`。两者都不能证明 `q` 之前的情况。失败查询只在请求偏移相同且依赖仍有效时复用。

一次协调过程中，每个匹配器只有一个活动候选。计算器同时保留该匹配器跨次协调已经产生的有序查询记录，不预先枚举所有可能匹配。前进游标单调遍历这些记录；新暴露空隙中的查询按原文顺序与旧记录合并，每个查询偏移只保留一条记录。未搜索区间必须执行匹配，不能虚构无匹配结论。

结果游标与匹配器搜索游标不同。结果协调从零开始，不代表无变化的匹配器需要从零重新扫描，它们的查询记录可以回答有效请求。各匹配器必须实现向前搜索，不能每次调用都重新收集剩余文本中的全部匹配。内部扫描、候选选择及结果比较仍有成本；调度保证针对实际匹配器调用，不宣称任意正则表达式都是线性的。

### 实际 Facts 依赖

`context.read(key)` 返回本次 Facts 快照中借用的只读值，并记录读取，包括 `undefined`。读取器仅在所属同步调用期间有效，不得保留。业务既不获得完整 Facts 对象，也不维护手工 `dependsOn` 列表或接收上一轮输出／缓存对象。

匹配器依赖集合是当前缓存代次所保留查询读取字段的并集，包括落败候选、无匹配查询和失败调用。字段变化按 `Object.is` 比较，外层 Facts 对象换引用不单独使匹配失效。规则失效时丢弃旧查询及读取集合，后续调用建立新的集合，因此已经不再读取的条件依赖不会永久残留。

产生 Text 的规则与其他规则共用查询缓存和依赖代次。空白开关更新只使它的读取者失效，不触发对已完成节点的无条件遍历。

### Facts、原文与注册刷新

Facts 更新只使实际读取变化字段的规则失效。它们的首次查询从原文零开始，其他规则保留查询记录；随后由同一个协调循环比较新候选和可复用候选。规则刷新不赋予额外优先权，新首个候选也不能掩盖更早旧赢家的消失。

新候选完全位于原有普通文字内时，可以拆分该 Text；无关匹配器的缓存仍覆盖新游标时，不调用它们。新候选输给更早的有效旧赢家时，丢弃新候选，不使旧赢家失效。新赢家覆盖其他候选时，只推进过期的候选头。赢家消失或缩短时，缓存的落败候选可以重新竞争；此前未搜索的区间在新暴露游标处触发查询。所有变化都使用同一个游标循环和查询覆盖规则。

多个 Facts 字段变化形成同一份快照和一个失效集合，所有受影响匹配器共同参与一次协调，不先提交某个更新再处理另一个。刷新结果等价时复用旧节点，所有元素相同则复用整个结果数组。协调在整份文档确定后发布结果。

原文变化会丢弃全部查询缓存，并以覆盖全文的 Text 作为上一版分段。新增或替换的规则定义从空缓存开始，无变化定义保留各自独立查询。规则移除时删除其依赖和候选。新增、移除或顺序变化后的协调仍使用相同选择逻辑，并可暴露此前被遮挡的候选。

### 输出、所有权与发布

节点保留 `{ id, start, end, data }`。业务节点使用所属匹配器 ID；Text 的 `data.text` 保留准确原文子串，`data.display` 可保存显示文字。输出有序、非重叠并完整覆盖原文。JSON 兼容性与只读所有权由 TypeScript 协议约束；计算器既不冻结借用对象，也不为隔离而深拷贝 Facts 或 payload。

文档计算器拥有全部缓存；注册表不持有计算器或文档订阅，不同文本实例不通过全局缓存共享状态。只有完整成功的求值才能发布新结果。匹配器失败时保留规则 ID 与 cause，不发布部分分段；实际读取仍参与依赖驱动的重试。禁止重入求值以及逃逸的同步读取 Context。

`conversation.user.text` 保持 session 作用域 Factory，拥有 keyed inline Slot `conversation.user.text.node`。React 消费最终节点，将 `raw` 和 `interactive` 交给业务 renderer。Session、skill、文件／目录和命令匹配仍归各插件所有，动作仍由各 renderer 的 Injection 提供，匹配与缓存订阅不进入 React。

`collapseWhitespace` 与 `trimWhitespace` 分别控制一个普通匹配器，缺省均关闭。Collapse 将空白串作为显示值为 `" "` 的 Text 候选；trim 将原文开头／末尾的空白串作为显示值为 `""` 的候选。Trim 的 order 小于 collapse，因此在同起点的边缘空白冲突中胜出。更早的引用候选消费自身完整范围，自然排除内部空白候选。每个 Text 候选保留准确的原文子串，emoji 及引用之间的空格保持不变。`interactive` 和 CSS `ellipsis` 仍为 React Props，不是匹配 Facts。Queue 使用完整原文和 CSS 省略，原生附件保留既有卡片及图片 Slot，不进入文本识别。
zh.alt: **按顺序处理整篇文档的业务变换。** 某业务可能在另一业务更早的引用获得考虑前消费后面的文本，因此固定类型顺序不能表达最左优先识别。
zh.cs: 字段级失效仍可能要求某个匹配器重新遍历文档，不承诺 Facts 字段内部逐元素失效。查询历史的内存量与当前原文、定义下记录的不同搜索位置成正比。协调及 JSON 引用对齐可能遍历输出而不调用匹配器。性能证据是准确的调度次数和查询偏移，语义证据是刷新结果与全新计算器的等价性。本机制不需要浏览器端到端测试或耗时基准测试。

en.t: Chat group-tree positions and exchanges
en.p: On next message folding kept only the last Turn of the loaded timeline expanded. A Turn woken by a notice (a settled subagent, goal round, schedule, or background job) is not submitted by this Client, yet its arrival made the preceding Turn historical and folded it. No own-input driver computed the exact remaining room for that fold, so the scroll layer reserved generic bottom space and a reader following the tail saw blank space. In the recorded Session the notice woke the next Turn 13–15 ms after the previous Turn ended; the minimal reproduction left 596 px blank that had not recovered after five seconds.
en.dc:
A notice is neither body text nor a user message: folding and bottom advancement ignore it. The bottom changes from the last Turn to the latest exchange.

- **Group-tree positions.** `ChatConversationViewNode.groupTree` declares a Node's position in the group tree, typed `ChatGroupTree = 'exchange' | 'input' | 'turn' | 'process'` and ordered outermost first; a Node at a position also has the effect of every inner position. `exchange` opens an exchange. `input` makes the Node an input of its Turn: before the Turn's process it is the opening input, after it an interleaved input that keeps the whole Turn open. `turn` keeps the Node outside the Turn's process disclosure, `process` keeps it inside the disclosure but outside step runs, and a Node without a position joins the surrounding step run. `isAtOrOutside(node, position)` is the single reader of that order: process grouping reads `process`, whole-Turn folding reads `turn`, Turn-input detection reads `input`, and exchanges read `exchange`.
- **Exchanges.** A Turn holding an `exchange` Node opens an exchange, which lasts until the next opening Turn.
