**Client Cordis service，例如 `ctx.assets.url(path)`。** 当前使用方都引用固定文件；运行时查找也拿不到内容 revision，除非另外发布每个包的资源清单。

**原始文件直接放在包根 `assets/`，不经构建。** 作者无法做预处理，命名和格式转换只能手工维护。

**revision 放在 `?rev=` 查询串，由 Host 校验。** Host 必须读完整个文件才能决定回 200 还是 404，首次请求要读两遍，还要按文件元数据缓存 hash；revision 写进文件名后，Host 只需解析路径并流式发送。

**用 `client.js` 的 revision 作为资源 revision。** 这个 revision 在构建写出 bundle 后才由文件元数据得出，来不及写进 bundle。

**CSS 只能经 JavaScript style 对象引用图片。** 遮罩、背景和 `@supports` 降级会被挪进组件，而 URL 在构建时就能确定，同一套规则也能改写 `url()`。

**与详情文档共用一套插件文件协议。** 详情图片要从本地、npm 或 Git 读取任意包版本，会触发 Host 网络访问因而需要鉴权，缓存方式也随来源而定。合并会把鉴权、来源提供方和缓存策略搬进 client-modules；在出现需要读取其他包文件的新使用方之前，Plugin Manager 和 Plugin Market 的详情路由保持独立。

**从 Plugin Manager 获取 manifest，或给 manifest 缓存加变化检查。** Plugin Manager 只列出 bundle，不覆盖所有 client 行，而且从 profile 安装目录解析，而不是用运行中条目的 Loader 解析。问题出在时机：缓存活得比条目重启更久。每次对账重新读取并跳过未变化的结果，是删掉缓存，而不是给缓存加校验。
zh.cs:
- ui-settings-account 的 `client.js` 为 214 KB，账户和 ui-chat 的 bundle 都不再含图片 data URL；图片显示时多一次同源请求，可能晚于布局出现。
- `require.asset` 和 `require.async` 一样属于 bundle factory 契约；仓库外构建的包必须输出这个调用。WebWorker 预览在启动时为镜像里所有包资源创建 Blob URL，不论包是否启用，并在页面生命周期内保留。
- Desktop 转发层把 `/plugins/` 的缓存头改写为 `no-store`，Desktop 每次显示都会重新读取资源。
- Host 不比对文件内容与文件名中的 revision：原地修改 `lib/assets/` 下的文件会保留它的 immutable 缓存。这个目录只由构建写入。
- `require.resolve` 在每次请求时同步执行；本机实测文件存在约 43 µs，不存在约 170 µs。它经 Node 的包配置缓存读取 exports，因此原地修改的 `./assets/*` 导出要等 boot HMR 让该包失效或 Host 重启后才生效。路由不检查解析结果的真实路径，所以 `lib/assets/` 下指向包外的符号链接会被提供。
- 仓库外的包必须复刻产出文件名规则和 `require.asset` 调用；Client 模块系统 README 记录了它们。
- 开发期间 `lib/assets/` 会留下旧的资源文件，直到下一次一次性构建把它们清掉；这种清理的前提是浏览器 face 是该目录的唯一写入方。
- 条目重启时会读取它的 manifest 并 stat 它的 bundle；只有结果变化时才读取 bundle 并广播启动图帧（69 行时约 30 KB）。只改 `package.json` 而条目没有重启时，仍要到下次条目重启或 Host 重启才生效。

en.t: Durable Computer Use consent within one profile
en.p: Application grants stored as plugin configuration make each authorization change depend on configuration reconciliation. Process-local conversation decisions also disappear when the same conversation resumes after a restart. A shared in-memory storage handle cannot observe another process revoking permission.
en.dc:
The CUA owner uses the existing domain storage service, with one domain per canonical profile directory. It stores long-term grants and conversation decisions by native application identity. Conversation IDs scope permission without turning it into permission for every conversation. The native identity policy remains owned by [bundle-ID consent](2026-10-25-cua-bundle-id-consent.md); this note replaces only that note's storage and restart-lifetime choices.

Every operation opens fresh domain state while holding the profile's existing file-lock primitive and closes the domain before releasing the lock. Native dispatch and revocation use a separate lock for the selected application. Storage reads and unrelated applications remain available during a native call. Revocation cancels this process's affected work first, then commits after other processes' already-admitted operations have finished. A completed revocation therefore leaves no operation using the old authority. App-wide revocation generations and per-conversation decision revisions prevent an old handle or delayed answer from restoring revoked access.

The JSON backend remains the shipped default. The domain name contains the SHA-256 digest of the canonical profile directory, isolating profiles that share one storage root. Legacy `allowedApps` is imported once; a persisted migration marker prevents an old configuration from restoring a revoked grant. Users can remove that configuration after checking the migrated list. Corrupt or unavailable profile storage fails closed. A composition without a profile has only temporary conversation state.
en.alt:
**Keep authorization in configuration.** It preserves existing storage but retains configuration-write and HMR coupling for runtime application decisions.

**Keep one domain open and rely on change events.** Domain notifications are process-local. Another host could continue to use stale grants after revocation.

**Add a new watcher, revision file or authorization broker.** The existing domain and file-lock primitives provide fresh reads and serialized operation admission without a new shared storage or IPC framework. Operations on the same application are serialized across processes; other applications and their conversation decisions remain independent.
en.cs:
File locks coordinate processes on one machine and PID namespace. A network-mounted profile shared across hosts is unsupported. Revocation may wait for another process's native call to settle. No timer establishes authorization validity.

The permission page still omits conversation-only grants and reads current state on entry, focus, actions and reconnection. Storage changes do not emit configuration events. System permissions remain owned by macOS. Tests cover restart retention, profile isolation, another process's write, cancellation, corrupted data, legacy import and non-resurrection after revocation. Stored conversation records currently require explicit retention management rather than automatic eviction.

zh.t: 同一 profile 内的持久 Computer Use 授权
zh.p: 把应用许可保存为插件配置，会让每次授权变更依赖配置重组。只保存在进程内的会话决定，也会在重启后恢复同一对话时丢失。长期持有的内存存储句柄无法观察另一个进程的撤销操作。
zh.dc:
CUA 使用现有域存储服务，每个 profile 的真实目录对应独立存储域，按本机应用身份保存长期许可和会话决定。对话 ID 限定权限范围，不把本会话许可扩展为所有对话的许可。本机身份规则仍由[Bundle ID 授权](2026-10-25-cua-bundle-id-consent.zh.md)负责，本记录仅替代其中的存储和重启后有效期选择。

每个操作使用现有文件锁，在 profile 锁内打开并读取最新存储状态，关闭域后才释放锁。原生操作和撤销使用单独的目标应用锁；原生调用期间仍可读取存储或访问其他应用。撤销先取消本进程中受影响的工作，再等待其他进程已获准执行的操作结束后提交。因此，撤销完成后不会留下仍使用旧授权的操作。应用级撤销代次和各对话的决定版本，阻止旧句柄或迟到回答恢复被撤销的访问权限。

随附配置继续使用 JSON 后端。域名包含 profile 真实目录的 SHA-256 摘要，隔离共用存储根目录的不同 profile。旧 `allowedApps` 只导入一次，持久化迁移标记阻止旧配置恢复已撤销的许可。用户确认列表迁移完成后可删除旧配置。profile 存储损坏或不可用时拒绝访问。没有 profile 的组合只保留临时会话状态。
zh.alt:
**继续将授权保存在配置中。** 可以复用旧存储，但运行时应用决定仍依赖配置写入和 HMR。

**长期打开域并依赖变更事件。** 域事件只在进程内传播，另一个宿主可能在撤销后继续使用旧许可。

**增加新的监听器、版本文件或授权代理。** 现有域存储和文件锁已经能提供最新状态与串行准入，无须增加通用存储或 IPC 框架。不同进程对同一应用的操作串行执行，其他应用及其会话决定保持独立。
zh.cs:
文件锁协调同一电脑及 PID 命名空间中的进程，不支持跨主机共用网络目录。撤销可能等待其他进程的原生调用结束。授权是否有效不由计时器决定。

权限页仍不显示仅对单个会话生效的许可，在进入页面、返回窗口、完成操作和重连后读取最新状态。存储变更不发送配置事件，系统权限仍归 macOS 管理。测试覆盖重启恢复、profile 隔离、其他进程写入、取消、数据损坏、旧配置导入和撤销后不恢复。已保存的会话记录目前需要显式管理保留期限，不自动淘汰。

en.t: File drag ownership outside the application layout
en.p: Image dragging spans conversation images, sidebar previews, and composer drop targets. Original files must survive source unmount during a drag, and failures must remain visible after the originating panel closes. An application-root image provider puts feature state in layout and makes independent image entries depend on an undeclared React ancestor.
en.dc: The [file-drag plugin](../../../../packages/client/ui-file-drag/README.md) owns generic file preparation, browser transfer tokens, retained original files, desktop bridge selection, and transient failure feedback. Consumers receive preparation and error callbacks through their slot or Factory injection. The plugin registers its feedback through `shell.overlay`; layout declares the generic slot and has no image dependency. The shared image primitive owns gestures and cancellation. Images are the first consumer, while MIME naming and transport accept other files.
en.alt:
**Root React provider.** It preserves transfer lifetime but adds image-specific assembly to the layout package and hides dependencies from slot registration. Moving the same wrapper into the renderer would move the feature coupling into another generic owner.

**State on each image.** It avoids shared assembly but cannot deliver the retained file after the source unmounts or keep a late failure visible after the panel closes.

**Direct browser File only.** Manual macOS Chrome 154.0.8037.93 drags of PNG and PDF fixtures produced a populated `dataTransfer.files` in trusted `dragstart`, but empty files in trusted same-page and cross-window drops. Finder received filename-only text clippings. These measured failures require the application-local token path; they do not establish behavior in untested browsers or cross-tab delivery. Desktop retains Electron native file dragging.
en.cs: One plugin lifetime governs transfer state, a native source-node end listener, and drop completion. The source listener remains attached after React unmount. Independent render roots can share a transfer without sharing a React ancestor. Custom compositions must load the service and declare the feedback slot; custom image Factory registrations supply the required callbacks. Application-local browser tokens are accepted only over the composer; native Desktop files retain the full-page drop overlay. Plugin disposal removes feedback and clears retained files. Loader-backed browser scenarios cover source removal and delivery, while focused tests cover local resource authorization and cleanup failures.

zh.t: 应用布局之外的文件拖放归属
zh.p: 图片拖放跨越会话图片、侧栏预览和输入框接收区。拖动期间原始文件必须在源组件卸载后继续保留，发起操作的面板关闭后失败提示也必须可见。应用根部的图片 Provider 把功能状态放进布局，并使独立图片入口依赖未声明的 React 祖先组件。
zh.dc: [文件拖放插件](../../../../packages/client/ui-file-drag/README.zh.md) 持有通用文件准备、浏览器传递令牌、原始文件、桌面桥接选择和临时失败提示。消费方通过 slot 或 Factory 注入接收准备及错误回调。插件通过 `shell.overlay` 注册提示，布局只声明通用插槽，不依赖图片功能。共享图片原语负责手势与取消。图片是首个调用方，MIME 命名与传输也接受其他文件。
zh.alt:
**根部 React Provider。** 它能保留传递生命周期，但会把图片专属组合放进布局包，并对 slot 注册隐藏依赖。把同一个包裹组件移到渲染器，只会把功能耦合转移到另一个通用模块。

**每张图片独立持有状态。** 这能避免共享组合，却不能在源组件卸载后交付保留文件，也不能在面板关闭后继续显示延迟到达的失败提示。

**仅直接传递浏览器 File。** 在 macOS Chrome 154.0.8037.93 中手动拖放 PNG 与 PDF 时，可信 `dragstart` 中 `dataTransfer.files` 有文件，同页与跨窗口的可信 drop 却收到空文件列表。Finder 收到仅含文件名的文本摘录。这些实测失败要求保留应用内令牌路径，但不能据此判定未测试浏览器或跨标签页交付的行为。Desktop 保留 Electron 原生文件拖放。
zh.cs: 一个插件生命周期管理传递状态、源节点上的原生结束监听器与投放完成。React 卸载后，监听器仍绑定源节点。独立渲染根可以共享传递，而不共享 React 祖先组件。自定义组合必须加载服务并声明反馈插槽，自定义图片 Factory 注册提供所需回调。应用内浏览器令牌仅在输入框范围接受；Desktop 原生文件保留全页投放遮罩。插件卸载会移除提示并清除保留文件。通过 Loader 启动的浏览器场景覆盖源图移除与交付，定向测试覆盖本地资源授权和清理失败。

en.t: Pi-ai system reminder fallback
en.p: Pi-ai concatenates later system messages into the initial prompt for models without native mid-conversation system support. Later system messages supplied to the adapter therefore invalidate the preceding conversation cache prefix.
en.dc:
The pi-ai adapter uses the prepared model's existing `supportsMidConvoSystemMessages` capability mapping. It preserves native system messages on capable models and converts each non-empty later system message into a user message wrapped in `<system-reminder>` otherwise, before pi-ai receives the context. Leading system text remains in the initial prompt. Message order, repeated updates, and existing text-block concatenation remain intact. Durable messages retain their original roles.

The fallback belongs to the adapter because it depends on the selected protocol capability. Prompt admission remains owned by the agent loop, which consolidates system-prompt updates on routes without native support; this fallback only handles later system messages present in the supplied request.
en.alt:
**Let pi-ai concatenate updates.** Retains system-role priority but changes the initial prompt whenever later system text changes, defeating prefix reuse.

**Advertise native support or send developer messages.** Misstates model capability or relies on another unsupported instruction role. The fallback uses ordinary user messages and does not change capability metadata.
en.cs: The wrapper does not confer system-role authority, so reminders have user-role priority. Cache hits remain provider-dependent; tool changes and compaction can still invalidate prefixes. Both text-only and attachment-aware conversion apply the same fallback, and wire tests inspect the real pi-ai serializer output.

zh.t: Pi-ai 系统提醒回退
zh.p: 对于不原生支持对话中系统消息的模型，pi-ai 会把后续系统消息拼接进初始提示词。因此，传给适配器的后续系统消息会使此前的对话缓存前缀失效。
zh.dc:
pi-ai 适配器使用已准备模型的现有 `supportsMidConvoSystemMessages` 能力映射。对于具备该能力的模型，适配器保留原生系统消息；否则，在 pi-ai 接收上下文之前，将每条非空的后续系统消息转换为以 `<system-reminder>` 包裹的用户消息。开头的系统文本仍位于初始提示词中。消息顺序、重复更新和现有文本块拼接方式均保持不变。持久消息保留原始角色。

回退由适配器负责，因为它取决于所选协议的能力。提示词纳入仍由 Agent loop 负责，它在不支持原生更新的路由上合并系统提示词更新；此回退仅处理传入请求中已有的后续系统消息。
zh.alt:
**让 pi-ai 拼接更新。** 保留系统角色优先级，但后续系统文本每次变化都会改变初始提示词，破坏前缀复用。

**宣称原生支持或发送 developer 消息。** 错报模型能力，或依赖另一种不受支持的指令角色。回退使用普通用户消息，不改变能力元数据。
zh.cs: 包裹文本不会赋予系统角色权限，因此提醒具有用户角色优先级。缓存命中仍取决于提供方；工具变化和压缩仍可能使前缀失效。纯文本与附件感知转换使用相同的回退，线协议测试检查真实 pi-ai 序列化器的输出。

en.t: New Session reuses a blank Session, matching a requested preset
en.p:
In 0.2.0-rc.2, New Session (the sidebar button, the Workspace "+" button, and the shortcut, all calling `uiWorkspace.startSession` without options) reused the Workspace's first blank Session. PR #5775, first released in `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.2`, changed it to create a fresh Session and Agent on every call, so that New Session composes the current preset definition after the user changes one instead of keeping a reused blank's earlier composition ([upgrade guide](../../../../docs/upgrade-guide/v0.2.1-alpha.1/new-session-generations/guide.md)).

A blank Session that is not current is hidden from the Session tree, and New Session is the only way back to it. After that change, a user who types a draft into a blank Session, switches to another Session, and clicks New Session lands in another empty Session; the original draft stays in localStorage under the old Session id, but no control returns to it. 0.2.1-rc.2 therefore loses New Session's unsent drafts.

The Creator entries (`startSession(…, { agentPreset: 'cordis', prompt, clearPreviousDraft: false })`) also reuse the first blank Session and switch it to Creator: an existing ordinary draft stays under Creator mode and the Creator prompt is not filled in, and New Session can likewise take over a Creator blank.
en.dc:
Only the Client (`ui-workspace`) changes; the Host is unchanged:

- `startSession` without options takes the reuse path again and follows the same rule as `openWorkspace`, `connectWorkspace`, and `startSession` with options.
- `createInWorkspace` names the first unstarted, unarchived blank Session that is still a Workspace member. A request that names a preset skips a blank whose listed preset (`projectionValues.agentPreset`) is a different one, while a blank with no listed preset remains eligible; a request without a preset may name any blank, which the Host switches to its default preset. The Host creates a Session when no blank is eligible.

As a result, New Session returns to the original blank Session with its unsent draft, and preset flows such as the Creator entries do not take over a blank that lists another preset, so an ordinary draft is not moved under Creator. No persisted state is added, and the Client does not read the preset roster.
en.alt:
**Revert the PR #5775 change completely, reusing the first blank for every request.** Drafts come back, but preset flows such as the Creator entries take over the blank holding the user's ordinary draft, switch it to Creator, keep the draft there, and cannot fill in their prompt.

**Keep creating a fresh Session and move the abandoned blank's draft into it.** This needs rules for which blank to move from when several exist, how to treat attachments, and whether to archive the old Session, which is more change and state than reusing blanks.

**Let a request without a preset reuse only a blank of the Host default preset.** The Client does not know the default preset and would have to request the `agentPresets.list()` roster.

**Record a persisted source-to-blank-Session map in the Client.** It duplicates the preset each blank already records and must handle stale entries and per-origin isolation.

**Clear the existing draft in place when the preset changes (`clearPreviousDraft: true`).** It deletes a draft the user was writing in the other mode.

**Also change the Host to always call `presets.select` when reusing a loaded blank.** It fully keeps #5775's goal but is outside this Client-only fix; see Deferred work.
en.cs:
- New Session no longer guarantees the current preset definition: a reused blank whose Agent is still loaded in the Host with the same preset id keeps its creation-time composition; a blank resumed after a Host restart composes the current definition.
- New Session may reuse a blank left by a preset flow such as the Creator entries; the Host switches it back to the default preset and its draft stays.
- The [new-session-blank-reuse](../../../../docs/upgrade-guide/v0.2.1-rc.2/new-session-blank-reuse/guide.md) upgrade guide records the change relative to 0.2.1-rc.2.

zh.t: 新会话复用空白会话，指定预设时按预设匹配
zh.p:
0.2.0-rc.2 中，新会话（左侧栏按钮、工作区“+”和快捷键，均调用不带选项的 `uiWorkspace.startSession`）复用工作区内第一个空白会话。PR #5775（首次发布于 `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.2`）改为每次新建 Session 与 Agent，目的是在用户修改预设定义后，新会话按当前定义装配，而不是沿用复用空白会话的旧装配（[升级指南](../../../../docs/upgrade-guide/v0.2.1-alpha.1/new-session-generations/guide.zh.md)）。

空白会话不是当前会话时不在 Session 树中显示，返回它的唯一入口是新会话。改为每次新建后，用户在空白会话中写下草稿、切到其他会话再点新会话，会进入另一个空的 Session；原草稿仍按会话 id 保存在 localStorage，但没有界面入口可以回到它。0.2.1-rc.2 因此丢失新会话的未发送草稿。

此外，创造模式入口（`startSession(…, { agentPreset: 'cordis', prompt, clearPreviousDraft: false })`）复用第一个空白会话并把它切换到 Creator：已有普通草稿时，草稿留在 Creator 模式下，Creator 提示语不会填入；反之新会话也可能接管 Creator 的空白会话。
zh.dc:
只修改前端（`ui-workspace`），Host 不变：

- 不带选项的 `startSession` 重新走复用分支，与 `openWorkspace`、`connectWorkspace` 和带选项的 `startSession` 使用同一规则。
- `createInWorkspace` 在未开始、未归档、仍属于该工作区的空白会话中选第一个。请求指明预设时，跳过列出的预设（`projectionValues.agentPreset`）为其他值的空白会话，未列出预设的空白会话仍可用；请求未指明预设时任何空白会话都可用，由 Host 切换到默认预设。没有可用的空白会话时由 Host 新建。

结果：新会话回到原来的空白会话，未发送的草稿保留；创造模式等预设流程不会接管列出其他预设的空白会话，用户的普通草稿不会被切到 Creator 下。不新增持久化状态，前端也不读取预设名单。
zh.alt:
**完全回退 PR #5775 的这项改动，所有请求都复用第一个空白会话。** 草稿可以回来，但创造模式等预设流程会接管用户普通草稿所在的空白会话，把它切到 Creator，草稿留在 Creator 下，提示语也填不进去。

**保持每次新建，把被丢下的空白会话中的草稿迁移到新会话。** 需要定义多个空白会话时迁移哪一个、附件如何处理、旧会话是否归档，改动和状态都比按预设复用多。

**未指明预设的请求只复用 Host 默认预设的空白会话。** 前端不知道默认预设，需要额外请求 `agentPresets.list()` 名单。

**在前端记录“来源 → 空白会话 id”的映射并持久化。** 与空白会话自身记录的预设重复，需要处理映射过期、按浏览器 origin 隔离等问题。

**预设变化时在原会话上清空草稿（`clearPreviousDraft: true`）。** 会删除用户在另一种模式下写到一半的草稿。

**同时修改 Host，让复用内存中的空白会话时总是调用 `presets.select`。** 能完整保留 #5775 的目的，但不在本次只修前端的范围内，见“推迟工作”。
zh.cs:
- 新会话不再保证使用当前预设定义：复用的空白会话若其 Agent 仍在 Host 内存中且预设 id 相同，沿用创建时的装配；Host 重启后恢复的空白会话按当前定义装配。
- 新会话可能复用创造模式等预设流程留下的空白会话，Host 把它切回默认预设，其中的草稿保留。
- 升级指南 [new-session-blank-reuse](../../../../docs/upgrade-guide/v0.2.1-rc.2/new-session-blank-reuse/guide.zh.md) 记录相对 0.2.1-rc.2 的行为变化。

en.t: PTC Script evaluation and state retention
en.p: Program syntax and memory lifetime answer different questions. A consumer may need Script declarations and completion values while requiring either a fresh environment or retained references. Inferring memory lifetime from REPL syntax prevents that choice.
en.dc:
The Node provider adds `executionMode: vm-script` and a separate `scriptPersistence` option, defaulting to false. `PtcRuntime.programFormat` describes accepted syntax; `retainsState` describes owner-scoped memory. Consumers use the latter for persistence controls and guidance. Existing `per-call` and `persistent-in-memory` configurations retain their meanings and defaults.

This extends the mode-naming decision in [best-effort persistent PTC](2026-09-23-best-effort-persistent-ptc.md), whose ownership, non-durability and recovery decisions remain active. The Node provider selects its evaluator once and shares managed process mechanisms across temporary and retained lifetimes. AsyncFunction, REPL and Script remain separate evaluator implementations, so process reuse does not define syntax.

VM Script uses a separate realm inside the managed child process. Top-level await uses the Node.js v26.6.0 REPL transform, with Acorn and acorn-walk supplying parsing and traversal. Detection precedes native compilation because non-strict Script can compile `await` as an identifier. The adapted visitors traverse computed method keys without entering method bodies. The source retains upstream attribution and license; the [package reference](../../../../packages/ptc-runtime/ptc-runtime-node/README.md#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) owns declaration and realm limitations.
en.alt:
**Replace existing modes with Script.** This would change async-function return syntax and REPL declaration behavior for existing consumers. An additional mode preserves those choices while exposing Script semantics.

**Encode syntax and retention in every mode name.** Separate names for fresh and retained Script would repeat syntax choices and encourage consumers to infer persistence from the format. One Script mode and an explicit retention option keep each fact separately observable.

**Use native Script without await conversion.** Native Script cannot evaluate top-level await. Parsing only after native compilation fails also misses valid programs where `await` compiles as an identifier. The Node transform supplies retained declarations and completion handling while keeping its known semantic tradeoffs explicit.

**Own a generic AST walker.** A local walker duplicates traversal provided by acorn-walk and must independently track new Acorn nodes. The maintained walker removes that implementation; only the evaluation-specific visitors remain local.
en.cs:
Script state is best-effort process memory, with the same explicit owner release and sandbox invalidation rules as retained REPL execution. It is neither serialized nor reconstructed by rerunning earlier programs. An uncaught callback exception or unhandled rejection terminates the Script process; programs must await asynchronous work.

The published format union now includes `script`, and custom retained providers must report `retainsState`. The [upgrade guide](../../../../docs/upgrade-guide/v0.2.1-rc.2/ptc-script-format/guide.md) describes consumer migration. Source deployments need the evaluator modules and Acorn packages; private process bundles include those dependencies.

zh.t: PTC Script 求值与状态保留
zh.p: 程序语法和内存生命周期回答不同的问题。消费者可能需要 Script 声明和完成值，同时要求全新环境或保留引用。根据 REPL 语法推断内存生命周期会阻碍这种选择。
zh.dc:
Node 提供方增加 `executionMode: vm-script` 和独立的 `scriptPersistence` 选项，后者默认为 false。`PtcRuntime.programFormat` 描述接受的语法，`retainsState` 描述按所有者保留的内存。消费者通过后者提供持久化控制和指引。已有 `per-call` 和 `persistent-in-memory` 配置保留原有含义与默认值。

本决策扩展[尽力保留 PTC 状态](2026-09-23-best-effort-persistent-ptc.zh.md)中的模式命名决策；其中的所有权、非持久存储及恢复决策仍然有效。Node 提供方一次性选择求值器，并在临时和保留生命周期之间共用受管进程机制。AsyncFunction、REPL 和 Script 仍是独立的求值器实现，进程复用不决定语法。

VM Script 在受管子进程内使用独立 realm。顶层 await 使用 Node.js v26.6.0 REPL 转换，由 Acorn 和 acorn-walk 提供解析与遍历。在原生编译之前检测 await，因为非严格 Script 可以将 `await` 编译为标识符。适配后的 visitor 遍历方法的计算属性名，但不进入方法体。源码保留上游署名和许可；[包参考](../../../../packages/ptc-runtime/ptc-runtime-node/README.zh.md#known-limitations-and-deferred-work)负责声明与 realm 限制。
zh.alt:
**用 Script 替换已有模式。** 这会改变现有消费者的异步函数返回语法和 REPL 声明行为。增加模式可在提供 Script 语义的同时保留已有选择。

**在每个模式名称中同时编码语法与保留方式。** 为全新和保留状态的 Script 分别命名，会重复语法选项，并鼓励消费者根据格式推断持久化。一个 Script 模式加显式保留选项，让两项事实可以分别观测。

**仅使用原生 Script，不转换 await。** 原生 Script 无法求值顶层 await。只在原生编译失败后解析，也会漏掉将 `await` 编译为标识符的有效程序。Node 转换提供声明保留和完成值处理，同时明确其已知语义取舍。

**自行维护通用 AST 遍历器。** 局部遍历器重复 acorn-walk 已提供的遍历功能，还必须独立跟踪新增 Acorn 节点。使用维护中的遍历器可以删除这部分实现，只保留与求值相关的局部 visitor。
zh.cs:
Script 状态是尽力保留的进程内存，遵循与保留 REPL 相同的显式所有者释放和沙箱失效规则。状态不会序列化，也不会通过重新执行旧程序重建。未捕获的回调异常或未处理的 Promise 拒绝会终止 Script 进程；程序必须等待异步工作。

公开格式联合类型现包含 `script`，自定义保留状态的提供方必须报告 `retainsState`。[升级指南](../../../../docs/upgrade-guide/v0.2.1-rc.2/ptc-script-format/guide.zh.md)说明消费者迁移。源码部署需要求值器模块和 Acorn 包，私有进程 bundle 包含这些依赖。

en.t: Replaceable product icons through an SVG sprite
en.p: Long-term skin customization needs themes to replace icons, not only colors. Product icons were React components that drew inline SVG paths, so a theme registered through `ctx.theme` could recolor them through `currentColor` but could not change their artwork. About 150 Client files import these components.
en.dc: Each product glyph weight is one sprite symbol, `dsw-icon-<glyph>-<weight>`. ui-primitives keeps the default SVG documents as `ICON_SYMBOLS`; an icon component keeps its export name, `size`, and `className`, and renders an `<svg>` box with one `<use>` of its symbol. ui-theme keeps one hidden sprite in the document whose `<symbol>` children come from the active theme's `ThemeDefinition.icons` replacements or the defaults. Artwork reached through `<use>` inherits `currentColor` and CSS custom properties from the use site, so a replacement can be multi-color, can paint with `--dsw-*` color tokens, and follows light and dark palettes without separate values.
en.alt:
- **Icons as CSS image tokens painted through `mask-image`.** Rejected after design review: a mask keeps only the image's alpha, so every icon stays one color, and a `url()` image cannot read CSS variables, so multi-color artwork could not follow color tokens. It would have reused the token override layer without a new theme field.
- **A runtime icon registry service with React components as values.** Rejected: components cannot read services or React context, so every icon import site would need a new prop or slot.
- **A slot per icon.** Rejected for the same caller cost; slots carry composition, not artwork.
en.cs:
- Icon DOM contains a `<use>` reference instead of paths; tests identify glyphs through `data-icon` and inspect artwork through `ICON_SYMBOLS`.
- Without ui-theme, the sprite is absent and icons render nothing.
- Every symbol shares the document id space, so `register` requires element ids inside a replacement to start with `<symbol id>-`; `<use>` in another document, such as an iframe, cannot reach the sprite.
- Replacement markup is trusted like the registering plugin's code; `register` rejects `<style>` and `<script>` only because they would apply to the whole document.
- Gradients and other paint servers resolve their stops where the sprite sits, so they follow palette tokens but not use-site color overrides.
- Default and token-colored replacement symbols render pixel-identically through `<use>` and inline in Chromium, WebKit, and Firefox.
- File-type, plugin, site, and brand artwork still render inline and are not replaceable yet.

zh.t: 通过 SVG sprite 实现可替换的产品图标
zh.p: 长期的皮肤定制需要主题能替换图标，而不只是颜色。产品图标原先是绘制内联 SVG 路径的 React 组件，因此通过 `ctx.theme` 注册的主题可以借助 `currentColor` 给它们换色，却无法更换图形。约 150 个 Client 文件导入了这些组件。
zh.dc: 每个产品图形的每种线重对应一个 sprite symbol `dsw-icon-<glyph>-<weight>`。ui-primitives 以 `ICON_SYMBOLS` 保存默认 SVG 文档；图标组件保留导出名、`size` 与 `className`，渲染一个 `<svg>` 框，其中包含一个引用自身 symbol 的 `<use>`。ui-theme 在文档中保留一个隐藏的 sprite，其 `<symbol>` 子元素来自活动主题的 `ThemeDefinition.icons` 替换项或默认值。通过 `<use>` 引用的图形会从使用处继承 `currentColor` 与 CSS 自定义属性，因此替换图形可以是多色的，可以用 `--dsw-*` 颜色 token 绘制，并且无需单独的值就能跟随浅色与深色调色板。
zh.alt:
- **把图标作为通过 `mask-image` 绘制的 CSS 图像 token。** 经设计评审后否决：遮罩只保留图像的 alpha，因此每个图标都只能是单色；`url()` 图像无法读取 CSS 变量，因此多色图形无法跟随颜色 token。该方案本可复用 token 覆盖层，而无需新增主题字段。
- **以 React 组件为值的运行时图标注册服务。** 否决：组件无法读取服务或 React context，因此每个图标导入处都需要新的 prop 或 slot。
- **每个图标一个 slot。** 因同样的调用方成本而否决；slot 承载的是组合，而不是图形。
zh.cs:
- 图标 DOM 包含 `<use>` 引用而不是路径；测试通过 `data-icon` 识别图形，通过 `ICON_SYMBOLS` 检查图形。
- 没有 ui-theme 时，sprite 不存在，图标不渲染任何内容。
- 所有 symbol 共享文档的 id 空间，因此 `register` 要求替换图形内的元素 id 以 `<symbol id>-` 开头；另一个文档（例如 iframe）中的 `<use>` 无法引用该 sprite。
- 替换标记与注册它的插件代码同等受信任；`register` 仅拒绝 `<style>` 与 `<script>`，因为它们会作用于整个文档。
- 渐变及其他绘制服务器在 sprite 所在位置解析其色标，因此它们跟随调色板 token，但不跟随使用处的颜色覆盖。
- 默认 symbol 与使用 token 着色的替换 symbol 在 Chromium、WebKit 与 Firefox 中通过 `<use>` 渲染与内联渲染的结果逐像素一致。
- 文件类型、插件、站点与品牌图形仍以内联方式渲染，暂不可替换。

en.t: Session snapshots, passive subscriptions, and Web aggregation
en.p: A point read, an event subscription, and a Web conversation opening have different lifetimes. Combining them inside one history controller makes passive observation perform unnecessary reads and gives each aggregate its own acquisition logic. Reading before subscribing also creates a gap that requires another read to repair. The APIs need independent operations that can compose without losing events or duplicating ownership.
en.dc:
`SessionController` is the single Session Remote Service. It owns ordinary `HistoryController`, `StateController`, and `WebController` instances, not three additional Cordis Services or Remote namespaces. The implementation separates six operations: history snapshot and observation, projection snapshot and observation, and state snapshot and observation. Follow and Wait compose those capabilities for their callers; the existing `page` entry forwards to the history reader.

### Reads and subscriptions

History reads return chronological records, `hasMore`, and an inclusive cursor. An omitted `throughSeq` selects the observed log end; `beforeSeq` selects older records without changing that read cut. Projection reads return exact sequenced values, sequence-free cache hints when migration is required, or null when the Session is absent. Live projection reads avoid persistence metadata access.

`usingObservation({ sessionId, projection }, signal, callback?)` acquires the existing disposable SessionObservation. A callback borrows it until the callback settles; without a callback the caller owns disposal. Ordinary history, state, and Wait output reads do not request projections. Follow, exact projection reads, and subagent history descriptor validation request them. No read activates an Agent implicitly.

`observeEvent` and `observeProjections` install listeners without acquiring an Observation. Their initial `ready` confirms subscription, not a snapshot cursor, existence, parent-child validity, or Agent readiness. History establishes continuity from its first received event; projection updates replace individual keys and may share a sequence number. `observeState` instead begins with a complete state read and coalesces later Session and Agent invalidations.

History, history observation, and Follow accept Address requests; projection and state operations accept Session IDs. All internal readers and listeners use Session IDs. History and Follow validate Address against their opening Observation at the Controller layer, including the existing subagent descriptor rules. Pure history observation does not acquire a read for entity validation. Gateway resource authorization remains independent: the registered Session resolver extracts the target ID from the request before access is decided.

### Follow ordering and ownership

Follow installs history and optional assistant listeners first, then acquires one projected Observation. It captures the assistant baseline and binding-local arrival ordinal synchronously, sets both cuts, publishes the opening snapshot, and consumes the shared output queue. History notifications at or before the snapshot cursor and assistant notifications at or before the ordinal are discarded at consumption. Later notifications remain ordered without a second history read, background merge pumps, or a tail repair introduced by the opening itself.

`session/created` contributes constructor seed events through the same history buffer. The adapter retains the supplied Session and its captured end position, then reads that in-memory prefix when consumed; it does not acquire another Observation. Each binding owns its subscriptions; a shared output queue belongs to Follow rather than to either listener.

Follow activates only when the caller passes `activate: true`; the Web Client does so explicitly. Background promotion starts once the opening is computed and before it is delivered, and does not promise Agent readiness. Ordinary promotion reuses the existing Agent controller and receives a separately retained Observation. Either Follow releases its opening Observation once the opening is computed, before yielding it; activation continues on the separately retained lease, so the cold entry's reference count drops to that lease alone. Subagent Sessions do not use ordinary promotion.

### State and Wait

State contains the event cursor, active and running flags, the complete readable queue or null, and pending-input kinds. It exposes neither a header nor an internal revision. Gateway owns unsettled Remote events; State samples their detached metadata and classifies approval, question, or other input without copying a request registry.

Wait evaluates complete states, confirms active-Agent quiescence with `whenIdle`, and rejects stale observations using listener-local revisions and Agent/Session identity checks. Session and Agent events wake reads immediately; while waiting, a one-second recheck detects pending input that produces no such event. This avoids adding a Gateway change event, at the cost of polling and bounded sampling delay rather than instantaneous notification. `observeState` does not poll, so pending-only changes need another state invalidation to become visible there.

Wait returns idle, input-required, or timeout with the last state it accepted and bounded assistant output. Output contains only `assistant/message` records in `(afterSeq, state.cursor]`, newest first, and reports truncation only when another eligible record exists. The caller's cancellation signal controls that output read independently of the expired wait deadline. A wait that accepts no state before its deadline fails instead of inventing a state.
en.alt:
**Read history, then subscribe and repair the gap.** Subscription-before-read already captures opening-time increments. A second read adds acquisition and replay obligations without improving that ordering.

**Give pure subscriptions an Observation or ready cursor.** These values conflate subscription readiness with an independently selected read cut. Callers that need both subscribe and buffer first, then read and discard covered increments.

**Keep separate Remote Services for the implementation controllers.** The classes divide behavior, not external service identity. One Session Service owns their composition, resource policy, and Remote entry points.

**Have Gateway interpret pending input or emit Session status.** Gateway only owns Remote event transport and unsettled-event metadata. State owns classification; Wait's periodic sampling avoids adding a transport notification solely for Session waiting.

**Merge assistant and history with independent asynchronous pumps.** One caller-owned buffer retains cross-source arrival order without extra pump cancellation or queue ownership. Snapshot construction and per-binding buffering retain distinct lifetimes.
en.cs:
The standard reads and Web aggregate share one Observation acquisition path, while pure subscriptions remain read-free. The old combined History controller is removed; still-used pagination, validation, and wire helpers remain at their original path. Cancellation, consumer termination, failed opening reads, and Context disposal release subscriptions and owned leases without cancelling Agent execution.

The [Observation decision](2026-08-25-session-observations-and-projection-owned-client-state.md) remains the authority for exact read cuts and projection derivation. The [history and Remote transport decision](2026-08-18-session-history-and-event-transport.md) retains ownership of Client reconnection and transport lifetimes. This decision refines Session API composition rather than replacing either broader decision.

The migrated history, cold-read, and transport tests exercise the new classes, including cursor overlap, assistant ordinal cuts, sequence gaps, subagent validation, and teardown. Slow consumers can still retain queued notifications; silent dropping is not a supported recovery strategy. Independent completion-acknowledged activation is not implemented by these reads or by Follow's background activation option.

zh.t: Session 快照、纯订阅与 Web 聚合
zh.p: 定点读取、事件订阅和 Web 会话开场具有不同的生命周期。把它们合并在同一个历史控制器中，会使被动观察执行不必要的读取，并让每个聚合各自维护获取数据的逻辑。先读后订阅还会产生需要再次读取来修复的缺口。接口需要相互独立的操作，使组合既不丢事件，也不重复资源所有权。
zh.dc:
`SessionController` 是唯一的 Session Remote Service。它持有普通的 `HistoryController`、`StateController` 和 `WebController` 实例，而不是额外的三个 Cordis Service 或 Remote namespace。实现分离六个操作：历史快照与观察、投影快照与观察、状态快照与观察。Follow 和 Wait 为调用方组合这些能力；已有的 `page` 入口转发到历史读取器。

### 读取与订阅

历史读取返回时间正序的记录、`hasMore` 和包含末项的游标。省略 `throughSeq` 时选择观察到的日志末尾；`beforeSeq` 只选择更早的记录，不改变读取点位。投影读取返回精确的有序值、需要迁移时无序号的缓存提示，或在 Session 不存在时返回 null。live 投影读取不访问持久化元信息。

`usingObservation({ sessionId, projection }, signal, callback?)` 获取已有的可释放 SessionObservation。有回调时租约借给回调直到其结束；无回调时由调用方释放。普通历史、状态及 Wait 输出读取不请求投影。Follow、精确投影读取和子会话历史 descriptor 校验请求投影。读取不会隐式激活 Agent。

`observeEvent` 和 `observeProjections` 安装监听而不获取 Observation。首个 `ready` 确认订阅生效，不代表快照游标、实体存在、父子关系有效或 Agent 就绪。历史从首个收到的事件建立连续性；投影更新替换单个键，多个更新可以共享序号。`observeState` 则从完整状态读取开始，并合并后续 Session 和 Agent 失效通知。

历史、历史观察和 Follow 接收 Address 请求；投影和状态操作接收 Session ID。所有内部读取器和监听器都使用 Session ID。History 和 Follow 在 Controller 层以开场 Observation 校验 Address，包括已有的子会话 descriptor 规则。纯历史观察不为实体校验获取读取。Gateway 资源授权与之独立：注册的 Session 解析器在访问判定前从请求提取目标 ID。

### Follow 顺序与所有权

Follow 先安装历史和可选 assistant 监听，再获取一份带投影的 Observation。它同步捕获 assistant 基线和绑定局部的到达序号，设置两种截断点，发布开场快照，然后消费共享输出队列。消费时丢弃序号不超过快照游标的历史通知，以及到达序号不超过截断点的 assistant 通知。后续通知保持顺序，无需第二次历史读取、后台合并任务，或由开场自身引入的尾部修复。

`session/created` 经同一历史缓冲提供构造期种子事件。适配器保留收到的 Session 及捕获的末尾位置，在消费时读取对应内存前缀，不获取另一份 Observation。每个绑定拥有自己的订阅；共享输出队列属于 Follow，而不是任一监听器。

只有调用方传入 `activate: true` 时 Follow 才激活；Web Client 显式传入该参数。后台提升在开场计算完成后、交付之前启动，不承诺 Agent 已就绪。普通提升复用已有 Agent controller，并接收单独 retain 的 Observation。两种 Follow 都在开场计算完成后、交付前释放开场 Observation；激活则继续使用单独 retain 的租约，因此冷 entry 的引用计数只剩那一份。子会话不走普通提升。

### 状态与 Wait

State 包含事件游标、active 与 running 标志、完整可读队列或 null，以及待输入种类。它不暴露 header 或内部 revision。Gateway 拥有未结算的 Remote 事件；State 采样独立元数据，将输入分类为 approval、question 或 other，不复制请求注册表。

Wait 判断完整状态，通过 `whenIdle` 确认活跃 Agent 已静止，并通过监听器局部 revision 和 Agent/Session 身份检查拒绝过时观察。Session 和 Agent 事件立即唤醒读取；等待期间每秒重查一次，检测没有产生上述事件的待输入请求。这避免新增 Gateway change 事件，代价是轮询和采样延迟，而非即时通知。`observeState` 不轮询，因此仅有 pending 变化时，需要另一项状态失效通知才会显示更新。

Wait 返回 idle、input-required 或 timeout，以及最后一次被接受的状态和有界 assistant 输出。输出仅包含 `(afterSeq, state.cursor]` 内从新到旧的 `assistant/message` 记录，只有存在另一条符合条件的记录时才报告截断。输出读取使用调用方的取消信号，不受已过期的等待截止信号控制。截止前没有任何状态通过校验的 wait 会失败，不构造虚假的状态。
zh.alt:
**先读历史，再订阅并修复缺口。** 先订阅后读取已经捕获开场期间的增量。第二次读取增加资源获取和重放责任，却不改善这个顺序。

**给纯订阅提供 Observation 或 ready 游标。** 这会混淆订阅就绪和独立选取的读取点位。需要两者的调用方先订阅并缓冲，再读取并丢弃已覆盖增量。

**为各实现 Controller 保留独立 Remote Service。** 这些类划分行为，而不是外部服务身份。一个 Session Service 拥有其组合、资源策略和 Remote 入口。

**让 Gateway 解释待输入状态或发送 Session status。** Gateway 只拥有 Remote 事件传输和未结算事件元数据。State 拥有分类；Wait 定期采样，避免仅为 Session 等待增加传输通知。

**用独立异步任务合并 assistant 与历史。** 调用方拥有的单个缓冲保留跨来源到达顺序，不引入额外任务取消或队列所有权。快照构造和各绑定缓冲仍保留不同生命周期。
zh.cs:
标准读取和 Web 聚合共享同一 Observation 获取路径，纯订阅不读取数据。旧的合并 History controller 已删除；仍使用的分页、校验和 wire 辅助函数留在原路径。取消、消费者结束、开场读取失败和 Context 释放都会释放订阅及拥有的租约，而不取消 Agent 执行。

[Observation 决策](2026-08-25-session-observations-and-projection-owned-client-state.zh.md)仍拥有精确读取点位和投影派生规则。[历史与 Remote 传输决策](2026-08-18-session-history-and-event-transport.zh.md)继续拥有 Client 重连和传输生命周期。本决策细化 Session API 组合，而不取代上述更广泛的决策。

迁移后的历史、冷读取和传输测试覆盖新类，包括游标重叠、assistant 到达序号截断、序号缺口、子会话校验和释放。慢消费者仍可能积累队列通知；静默丢弃不是支持的恢复策略。这些读取以及 Follow 的后台激活选项均未实现独立的、确认完成后返回的激活接口。

en.t: whenAccess registration that follows access
en.p:
Client plugins need to switch their own registrations on and off with the current Peer's access: sidebar entries, main panels, overlays, and data streams. The existing Client access surface covers only rendering:

| Where | Existing capability | Gap |
|---|---|---|
| Components | `useRemoteAccess(action)` (global), `useSessionAccess(sessionId, action)`, `useWorkspaceAccess(workspaceId, action)`, and the Session-scope `useAccess(action)` | Readable only during render; a changed answer re-renders automatically |
| JS (`apply`, services) | `ctx.remoteAccess.source(kind, id, action)` returns a `HostObservable<boolean>` | A plugin must read `getSnapshot` and subscribe to changes itself, then register and dispose by hand |

Without a JS entry point, a plugin can only decide its registrations once by identity at `apply`, and they do not follow an access change.
en.dc:
### whenAccess

The JS side has a `whenAccess` for each of the three access Hooks, from the package that publishes that Hook:

| Interface | Provider | Matching Hook |
|---|---|---|
| `ctx.remoteAccess.whenAccess(action, callback)` | remote-access | `useRemoteAccess(action)` |
| `ctx.uiSession.whenAccess(sessionId, action, callback)` | ui-session | `useSessionAccess(sessionId, action)` |
| `ctx.uiWorkspace.whenAccess(workspaceId, action, callback)` | ui-workspace | `useWorkspaceAccess(workspaceId, action)` |

```ts ignore-check
import type { AccessEffect, RemoteEndpoint } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remote-access/client'

/** The global-resource member; the Session and Workspace versions take the resource id first. */
export interface WhenAccess {
  /**
   * Keep `callback`'s effects installed while the current Peer may call `action`
   * on the resource: run it when the answer becomes true, dispose its effects in
   * reverse order when it becomes false, and run it again on the next true.
   * @returns disposer for the observation and any installed effects.
   */
  whenAccess(action: RemoteEndpoint, callback: () => AccessEffect): () => void
}
```

`AccessEffect` is `(() => void) | Iterable<() => void, void, void>`.

| Rule | Content |
|---|---|
| Semantics | Same as `ctx.slots.inject`: the callback returns one disposer or an iterable of disposers; an iterable installs as one transaction and disposes in reverse order; the controller belongs to the caller's fiber and disposes when the plugin unloads |
| Synchronous run | When the answer is already true, the callback runs synchronously; the owner's answer is always true, so registration order matches direct registration |
| Stream failure | A non-owner's answer turns false and the installed effects dispose |
| Callback failure | A setup failure at the call throws synchronously; a setup failure on a later grant stops the controller and is rethrown in a microtask |
| Layering | remote-access knows only `global`; the Session and Workspace versions are built over remote-access's lower-level `whenResourceAccess(kind, id, action, callback)`, as their Hooks are built over `source(kind, id, action)`. Only the package that owns a resource kind calls `source` and `whenResourceAccess`; other plugins use only the access Hooks and `whenAccess` and pass no kind. All four entry points share [`when-allowed.ts`](../../../../packages/api/remote-access/src/client/when-allowed.ts) |

### Plugin migration

| Plugin | Change | Action |
|---|---|---|
| ui-schedule | The task catalog source, delete toast overlay, right-sidebar task tab and title, main panel, sidebar entry, turn-tail card, Session-header reminder catalog, and Session row mark and hover list move into `remoteAccess.whenAccess`; the Session-header catalog reads the per-Session `schedule.list`, so its component also decides through the Session-scope `useAccess` whether to render; the task tab type and the turn definition stay registered outside | `schedule/catalog`, `schedule/list` |
| ui-plugin-manager | Host change subscriptions, refresh toast overlay, main panel (including `pluginNavigation`), and sidebar entry move into `remoteAccess.whenAccess`, and each grant refreshes a list already loaded; the controller and `pluginChanges` stay outside, and `pluginChanges` receives no updates while access is withdrawn. ui-entry-customization and voice-input use `pluginNavigation` optionally: without the service they hide the browse-plugins and open/details buttons and still start | `pluginManager/listBundles` |
| ui-settings-general | The settings shell `sidebar.settings` and the `settings.open` shortcut move into `remoteAccess.whenAccess` | `settings/describe` |
| ui-settings-account | The account state stream (including default model initialization), quota notice, settings launcher, account settings section, and `settings.models.sign-in` move into `remoteAccess.whenAccess`. On revocation the stream's disposer synchronously invalidates the account reads this grant started, closes the pending authorization tab, clears the account view, details, picture, and sign-in dialog state, ends this generation's bonus notices, which a frame of that stream begins, and then closes the stream; a frame delivered before the revocation but not yet handled is dropped. The notice controller stays outside and begins again under the next grant; the account section appears once the new stream's first frame arrives | `account/watch` |
| ui-directory-picker-native | Both directory flows move into `remoteAccess.whenAccess` | `directoryPicker/pick` |
| ui-message-feedback | The message feedback buttons stay registered and the component decides whether to render through the Session-scope `useAccess`; `messageFeedback/*` requests carry `sessionId`, which the Gateway resolves to that Session through the `session` resource's default field, so they declare nothing. The `/feedback` decoration has no Client check: the decoration registry is global while `sessionFeedback/record` is decided per Session, so without access the dialog still opens and the Host refuses the submission, which the dialog reports with its failure code | `messageFeedback/put` |
| ui-deliverables, ui-open-in-app | Unchanged: an owner-only HTTP route that cannot be read falls back as before | — |
en.alt:
**Return after an owner check at the start of `apply` (the #6486 approach)**: fixed on identity; does not follow an access change.

**Trim the plugin list per connection**: a plugin cannot reload at once when access changes.

**Declare access in the plugin package manifest**: defines an access-control concept in the package manifest.

**One generic method with a resource parameter, or all three versions on remote-access**: business code would pass a kind, and remote-access would name the Session and Workspace resource kinds.
en.cs:
| Consequence | Note |
|---|---|
| Registrations follow access changes | Without a grant, a migrated plugin registers none of the corresponding entries for a non-owner; they appear after a grant and disappear after a revocation; the owner's answer is always true, so its registrations match direct registration |
| The callback must hand back disposers | An effect registered through the plugin's `ctx` inside the callback also hangs on the plugin fiber; a registration whose disposer is not yielded does not dispose on access loss, only when the plugin unloads |
| Readers receive all plugin code | Plugins load as before; the Gateway decides each call, and `whenAccess` and the Hooks control the UI |
| Test stand-ins | [`dsh-client-test-runtime`](../../../../packages/test-support/client-runtime/README.md) replaces remote-access with fixed answers through `StaticRemoteAccess`, `staticAccessPlugin`, and `TestClientOptions.access`, so plugin specs cover the refused path |

zh.t: 按访问状态注册的 whenAccess
zh.p:
Client 插件需要按当前 Peer 的访问状态开关自己的注册：侧栏入口、主面板、浮层、数据流。现有 Client 访问面只覆盖渲染：

| 位置 | 现有能力 | 缺口 |
|---|---|---|
| 组件 | `useRemoteAccess(action)`（global）、`useSessionAccess(sessionId, action)`、`useWorkspaceAccess(workspaceId, action)`、会话作用域的 `useAccess(action)` | 只能在渲染时读，答案变化时自动重渲染 |
| JS（`apply`、服务） | `ctx.remoteAccess.source(kind, id, action)` 返回 `HostObservable<boolean>` | 插件要自己读 `getSnapshot`、订阅变化，再手动注册与撤销 |

没有 JS 侧入口时，插件只能在 `apply` 时按身份一次性决定注册与否，授权变化后注册不跟随。
zh.dc:
### whenAccess

JS 侧有与三个访问 Hook 一一对应的 `whenAccess`，由各自 Hook 的发布者提供：

| 接口 | 提供者 | 对应 Hook |
|---|---|---|
| `ctx.remoteAccess.whenAccess(action, callback)` | remote-access | `useRemoteAccess(action)` |
| `ctx.uiSession.whenAccess(sessionId, action, callback)` | ui-session | `useSessionAccess(sessionId, action)` |
| `ctx.uiWorkspace.whenAccess(workspaceId, action, callback)` | ui-workspace | `useWorkspaceAccess(workspaceId, action)` |

```ts ignore-check
import type { AccessEffect, RemoteEndpoint } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remote-access/client'

/** The global-resource member; the Session and Workspace versions take the resource id first. */
export interface WhenAccess {
  /**
   * Keep `callback`'s effects installed while the current Peer may call `action`
   * on the resource: run it when the answer becomes true, dispose its effects in
   * reverse order when it becomes false, and run it again on the next true.
   * @returns disposer for the observation and any installed effects.
   */
  whenAccess(action: RemoteEndpoint, callback: () => AccessEffect): () => void
}
```

`AccessEffect` 为 `(() => void) | Iterable<() => void, void, void>`。

| 规则 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 语义 | 与 `ctx.slots.inject` 相同：回调返回一个 disposer 或一组 disposer；一组时按事务安装、逆序撤销；控制器属于调用方 fiber，插件卸载时撤销 |
| 同步执行 | 调用时答案为 true 则回调同步执行；owner 的答案恒为 true，注册顺序与直接注册相同 |
| 快照流失败 | 非 owner 的答案变为 false，已安装的效果撤销 |
| 回调失败 | 调用时安装失败同步抛出；之后重新授权时安装失败，控制器停止并在微任务中抛出 |
| 分层 | remote-access 只认识 global；会话版与工作区版经 remote-access 的底层方法 `whenResourceAccess(kind, id, action, callback)` 实现，与它们用 `source(kind, id, action)` 构造 Hook 相同。`source` 与 `whenResourceAccess` 只由拥有该资源种类的包调用，其他插件只用访问 Hook 与 `whenAccess`，不传 kind。四个入口共用 [`when-allowed.ts`](../../../../packages/api/remote-access/src/client/when-allowed.ts) |

### 插件迁移

| 插件 | 改法 | action |
|---|---|---|
| ui-schedule | 任务列表数据源、删除提示浮层、右栏任务 tab 与标题、主面板、侧栏入口、turn 尾部卡片、会话头部提醒、会话行标记与悬浮列表包进 `remoteAccess.whenAccess`；会话头部提醒读取按会话判定的 `schedule.list`，组件另在会话作用域里用 `useAccess` 决定是否渲染；任务 tab 类型与 turn 定义的注册留在外面 | `schedule/catalog`、`schedule/list` |
| ui-plugin-manager | Host 变更订阅、刷新提示浮层、主面板（含 `pluginNavigation`）、侧栏入口包进 `remoteAccess.whenAccess`，每次授权时刷新已加载过的列表；controller 与 `pluginChanges` 留在外面，撤权期间 `pluginChanges` 不更新。依赖 `pluginNavigation` 的 ui-entry-customization 与 voice-input 改为可选使用：服务不在时隐藏「浏览插件」与「打开 / 查看详情」按钮，插件照常启动 | `pluginManager/listBundles` |
| ui-settings-general | 设置外壳 `sidebar.settings` 与 `settings.open` 快捷键包进 `remoteAccess.whenAccess` | `settings/describe` |
| ui-settings-account | 账号状态流（含默认模型初始化）、额度提醒、设置启动器、账号设置分区与 `settings.models.sign-in` 包进 `remoteAccess.whenAccess`。撤权时账号流的 disposer 同步作废这一轮发出的账号读取，关闭待授权的浏览器标签页，清空账号视图、详情、头像与登录对话框状态，结束本轮奖励提示（提示由该流的帧开始），再关闭流；撤权前已交付但尚未处理的帧被丢弃。提示控制器留在外面，下次授权时重新开始；账号分区等新流的第一帧到达后才出现 | `account/watch` |
| ui-directory-picker-native | 两个目录选择流程包进 `remoteAccess.whenAccess` | `directoryPicker/pick` |
| ui-message-feedback | 消息反馈按钮照常注册，组件在会话作用域里用 `useAccess` 判断是否渲染；`messageFeedback/*` 的请求带 `sessionId`，Gateway 按 `session` 资源的默认字段自动解析为该 Session，无需声明。`/feedback` 装饰不做前端判断：装饰注册表是全局的，而 `sessionFeedback/record` 按会话判定；没有权限时对话框照常打开，提交被 Host 拒绝并显示失败码 | `messageFeedback/put` |
| ui-deliverables、ui-open-in-app | 不动：owner 专用 HTTP 路由读不到时走已有回退 | — |
zh.alt:
**插件 `apply` 开头判断 owner 后 return（#6486 的做法）**：按身份写死，授权变化后不跟随。

**按连接裁剪插件列表**：授权变化后插件无法立即重新加载。

**插件包清单声明访问性**：在包清单上定义访问控制概念。

**一个带资源参数的通用方法，或三个版本都挂在 remote-access 上**：业务代码要传 kind，且 remote-access 会出现会话、工作区的资源种类名。
zh.cs:
| 后果 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 注册跟随授权变化 | 迁移的插件在非 owner 无授权时不注册相应入口，授予后出现，撤销后消失；owner 的答案恒为 true，注册与直接注册相同 |
| 回调必须交还 disposer | 回调里经插件 `ctx` 注册的效果也挂在插件 fiber 上；不 yield 其 disposer 的注册在失权时不会撤销，只在插件卸载时撤销 |
| 读者拿到全部插件代码 | 插件照常加载；访问由 Gateway 逐次判定，界面由 `whenAccess` 与 Hook 控制 |
| 测试替身 | [`dsh-client-test-runtime`](../../../../packages/test-support/client-runtime/README.zh.md) 的 `StaticRemoteAccess`、`staticAccessPlugin` 与 `TestClientOptions.access` 以固定答案替换 remote-access，供插件测试无权限路径 |

en.t: The official DeepSeek route follows the official model listing until its catalog is customized
en.p: The `deepseek-official` route offered whatever its `models` setting held, and that setting defaults to the catalog bundled with each build. A model the DeepSeek API added reached API-key users only through a release, while the account route already followed the service's `GET /models` listing at the same origin. Unlike the account route's catalog, the official route's catalog is user-editable: the Models page stores an edited catalog in `models`, and a gateway behind `baseURL` declares its models there.
en.dc:
- [`llm-deepseek-api-key`](../../../../packages/llm/llm-deepseek-api-key/README.md) follows `GET https://api.deepseek.com/models`, authenticated with the API key in `x-api-key`, only while the Messages origin is `https://api.deepseek.com` and `models` equals the built-in catalog. Any other endpoint or catalog sends no listing request.
- Loading, refresh, fallback, merging, and the client-version gate are the [account route's](2026-09-24-deepseek-account-remote-model-catalog.md): a first access waits up to `modelsTimeoutMs`, a listing older than `modelsMaxAgeMs` refreshes in the background on the next access, a failure keeps the last good listing or the built-in catalog, and the cache lives in memory, keyed by endpoint and key fingerprint.
- A customized `models` list wins whole: it replaces the catalog and stops listing requests. A list is customized when it resolves differently from the built-in catalog, because the schema default materializes an absent `models` as the built-in list and the Models page shows that default as its inherited rows.
- Switching between a customized catalog and the listing invalidates the cache from a `loader/volatile-update` listener, so Restore defaults reloads the listing on the next access even when the cached listing is fresh.
- The listing request, its cache, catalog resolution, and the gate live in the shared [Messages transport](../../../../packages/llm/llm-deepseek/README.md) because two routes consume them; the transport's provider hooks remain `connect` and `admit`.
en.alt:
**Follow the listing on every endpoint.** A gateway that publishes an OpenAI-style `/models` returns entries without `api_capabilities.anthropic_messages`, which the decoder hides, so the route would offer no models. Every such gateway would also receive an extra request carrying the key.

**Merge the customized catalog with the listing by model id.** Customized users would keep receiving new listed models, but a model the user deleted would return, and the Models page cannot hide one listed model.

**Mark an unset `models` by removing its schema default.** An absent value would select the listing without comparing catalogs, but the Models page would lose the inherited rows it shows and copies, with their hidden `systemPromptUpdate` and `toolUpdate` fields, into a customized catalog. Rows copied from the generic model-discovery API would drop those fields.

**Fetch once per process, or refresh on a timer.** A single fetch leaves a long-running Web or desktop host on its startup catalog, and one transient failure pins it to the built-in catalog. A timer sends requests while the route is idle. Access-triggered background refresh matches the account route.

**Reuse the cached listing after Restore defaults.** The cache could serve a listing loaded before the customization for up to `modelsMaxAgeMs`; the request is cheap, so restoring always reloads it. The reload starts on the next access rather than inside the listener, which keeps credential lookup and its failures on the request path; the Web page's settings refresh makes that access right after the save.
en.cs:
- API-key users on the official endpoint receive listed models without a release, and an older build hides or refuses a model that needs a newer client, as account users' builds do.
- A customized catalog receives no later listed models until Restore defaults, and a `models` list identical to the built-in catalog counts as uncustomized. The comparison uses the running version's built-in catalog, so a saved list equal to an earlier version's built-in catalog counts as customized once the built-in catalog changes.
- The Models page shows the built-in rows while the listing is followed, so a model only the listing offers appears only in model selectors, and editing the page's catalog drops it.
- The first catalog access on the official endpoint can wait up to `modelsTimeoutMs`, and a suite that boots the route there must answer the listing itself to stay off the network.

zh.t: DeepSeek 官方路由在目录未自定义时跟随官方模型列表
zh.p: `deepseek-official` 路由提供的是 `models` 设置里的内容，而这个设置默认是每个构建自带的目录。DeepSeek API 新增的模型只能随发版到达 API key 用户，而账号路由已经在同一个 origin 上跟随服务端的 `GET /models` 列表。与账号路由不同，官方路由的目录可以由用户编辑：模型页把编辑后的目录存进 `models`，`baseURL` 后面的网关也在这里声明自己的模型。
zh.dc:
- [`llm-deepseek-api-key`](../../../../packages/llm/llm-deepseek-api-key/README.zh.md) 只在 Messages 的 origin 是 `https://api.deepseek.com`、且 `models` 等于内置目录时，跟随 `GET https://api.deepseek.com/models`，并用 `x-api-key` 携带 API key 鉴权。其他端点或目录不发列表请求。
- 加载、刷新、兜底、合并与客户端版本门控沿用[账号路由](2026-09-24-deepseek-account-remote-model-catalog.zh.md)的规则：首次访问最多等待 `modelsTimeoutMs`，列表超过 `modelsMaxAgeMs` 后在下一次访问时后台刷新，失败时保留上一份成功的列表或使用内置目录，缓存只在内存中，以端点和 key 指纹为键。
- 自定义的 `models` 列表整份优先：它替换目录，并停止列表请求。解析结果与内置目录不同的列表才算自定义，因为 schema 默认值会把缺省的 `models` 物化为内置列表，模型页也把这个默认值显示为继承的行。
- 在自定义目录与列表之间切换时，一个 `loader/volatile-update` 监听器会让缓存失效，因此点恢复默认后，即使缓存的列表尚未过期，下一次访问也会重新加载。
- 列表请求、缓存、目录解析和门控放在共享的 [Messages 传输包](../../../../packages/llm/llm-deepseek/README.zh.md)中，因为现在有两条路由使用它们；传输层的提供方钩子仍然只有 `connect` 和 `admit`。
zh.alt:
**在所有端点上跟随列表。** 发布 OpenAI 风格 `/models` 的网关返回的条目没有 `api_capabilities.anthropic_messages`，解码器会隐藏它们，路由就不提供任何模型。每个这样的网关还会多收到一个携带 key 的请求。

**按模型 id 合并自定义目录与列表。** 自定义用户会继续收到新列出的模型，但用户删掉的模型会重新出现，而模型页无法隐藏某一个列出的模型。

**去掉 `models` 的 schema 默认值来标记未设置。** 缺省值不用比较目录就能选中列表，但模型页会失去它显示的继承行；这些行连同隐藏的 `systemPromptUpdate`、`toolUpdate` 字段会被复制进自定义目录。从通用模型发现 API 复制的行会丢掉这些字段。

**每个进程只获取一次，或按定时器刷新。** 只获取一次会让常驻的 Web 或桌面宿主停留在启动时的目录，一次偶发失败就会让它固定在内置目录。定时器会在路由空闲时发请求。由访问触发的后台刷新与账号路由一致。

**恢复默认后沿用缓存的列表。** 缓存可能在 `modelsMaxAgeMs` 内一直提供自定义之前加载的列表；列表请求代价很小，所以恢复默认总是重新加载。重新加载从下一次访问开始，而不是在监听器里进行，这样凭据查询及其失败都留在请求路径上；Web 页面保存后的设置刷新会立即发起这次访问。
zh.cs:
- 使用官方端点的 API key 用户无需发版就能看到列出的模型，旧构建会像账号用户的构建一样隐藏或拒绝需要新版客户端的模型。
- 自定义目录在恢复默认之前收不到之后列出的模型；与内置目录完全相同的 `models` 列表视为未自定义。比较的是当前版本的内置目录，所以保存的列表若等于旧版本的内置目录，内置目录变化后就算作自定义。
- 跟随列表期间，模型页仍显示内置的行，因此只有列表提供的模型只出现在模型选择器里，在模型页编辑目录会丢掉它。
- 官方端点上的第一次目录访问可能等待最多 `modelsTimeoutMs`，在该端点上启动路由的测试套件必须自己应答列表请求，才能不访问网络。

en.t: Ordinary forks have no durable creator relationship
en.p: Using `parentSession` for both copied history and delegation makes an ordinary fork appear to be a subagent. Consumers can emit false child-start notifications, hide resumable sessions, or impose source-relative ordering. Removing the writer alone leaves historical ordinary forks misclassified and exposes a V4 reader assumption: inherited delivery acknowledgements require a parent id even though the validated seed range already identifies copied events.
en.dc:
Ordinary forks preserve their complete selected prefix, `isSeeded`, `inheritedEventCount`, and inherited end-seed marker, but record no source id. Subagents retain their direct creator, including when their backend copies history. `origin: subagent` supplies coarse classification; a valid own-range descriptor separately supplies continuation identity. Historical parent metadata remains readable and unchanged. Runtime Agent ownership remains governed by the [explicit identity decision](2026-08-31-explicit-agent-runtime-identity.md).

The V4 reader permits another Session's delivery id only inside the validated inherited range. Own-range markers still require the current id, and every active-generation `throughSeq` must precede its marker. These checks do not require a persistent source relationship.
en.alt:
**Keep the source under another field.** A replacement such as `forkSourceId` preserves the durable relationship the user chose to remove, along with its downstream maintenance cost.

**Erase parent metadata from existing logs.** Historical mutation loses recorded information and violates immutable-generation guarantees. Consumers distinguish old ordinary forks without cleanup.

**Bump the format solely because older readers reject some new logs.** The existing inherited range and complete-log check prevent unsafe execution and truncation. A global bump and adjacent copy add no protection to this transition; same-version refusal has a documented diagnostic limitation.
en.cs:
Ordinary-fork source tracing is intentionally unavailable in new data. Manual ordering preserves saved positions and treats new forks like other ordinary sessions. Operation-local source access preserves title increments and workspace selection. The [side-session proposal](../../proposed/feature/2026-07-08-interactive-side-sessions.md) retains its separate handback idea but cannot use a stored ordinary-fork parent. Runtime ownership, projection-cache identity, and Team membership decisions remain independently useful and are not superseded.

Verification covers real fork/persist/reopen paths for ordinary, nested, historical, and subagent seeds, rejection without writes for foreign own-range delivery and invalid coordinates, SDK notification classification, ACP resume, client ordering, and title generation. TypeScript and Python recorded SDK scenarios create ordinary and nested forks plus historical parent-bearing metadata while retaining the expected real-subagent lifecycle.

zh.t: 普通 fork 不保留持久创建者关系
zh.p: 同时用 `parentSession` 表示复制历史和委派，会让普通 fork 看起来像子代理。消费方可能发送错误的子代理启动通知、隐藏可恢复会话，或施加相对来源的排序。仅删除写入仍会误分类历史普通 fork，并暴露 V4 reader 的一项假设：继承投递确认要求父 ID，尽管已验证的 seed 区间已经标识复制事件。
zh.dc:
普通 fork 保留完整的选定前缀、`isSeeded`、`inheritedEventCount` 及继承结束标记，但不记录来源 ID。子代理保留直接创建者，包括 backend 复制历史的情况。`origin: subagent` 提供粗粒度分类；有效的自身区间 descriptor 单独提供继续运行身份。历史父元数据保持可读且不变。运行时 Agent 归属仍遵循[显式身份决策](2026-08-31-explicit-agent-runtime-identity.zh.md)。

V4 reader 仅在已验证的继承区间中允许其他 Session 的投递 ID。自身区间标记仍要求当前 ID，每个活动代际的 `throughSeq` 必须早于其标记。这些检查不需要持久来源关系。
zh.alt:
**用其他字段保留来源。** `forkSourceId` 等替代字段保留了用户决定移除的持久关系及其下游维护成本。

**清除已有日志的父元数据。** 修改历史会丢失已记录信息，并违反代际不可变保证。消费方可以在不清理的情况下区分旧普通 fork。

**仅因旧 reader 拒绝部分新日志就升级格式。** 现有继承区间和完整日志检查阻止不安全执行与截断。全局升级和相邻复制不会为这次转换增加保护；同版本拒绝的诊断限制已有明确记录。
zh.cs:
新数据有意不支持普通 fork 的来源追踪。手动排序保留已保存位置，将新 fork 当作其他普通会话处理。操作期间访问来源保留标题递增和工作区选择。[侧会话提案](../../proposed/feature/2026-07-08-interactive-side-sessions.zh.md)保留独立的交回设想，但不能使用普通 fork 的持久父字段。运行时归属、投影缓存身份和 Team 成员关系决策仍分别有用，未被取代。

验证覆盖普通、嵌套、历史及子代理 seed 的真实 fork／持久化／重新打开路径，自身区间外来投递及非法坐标的无写入拒绝，SDK 通知分类、ACP 恢复、客户端排序与标题生成。TypeScript 和 Python 录制 SDK 场景创建普通及嵌套 fork 和携带历史父元数据的会话，同时保留真正子代理的预期生命周期。

en.t: Image reads use attachment-store access
en.p: Historical image loading read the requesting Session and searched its event content for every uncached attachment. The search established that the Session referenced the image; it did not locate the bytes, whose storage path already follows from the content-addressed ID. This added work proportional to history length to each image read. The reported loading delay also involved uploads; this finding alone does not identify all of that delay.
en.dc:
Session membership is not an image-access restriction. After connection authentication and Gateway permission checks authorize `session/attachment`, every caller may read any image in the same attachment store using a complete `ImageAttachmentRef`, including objects referenced only by other Sessions or not referenced at all. The request retains `sessionId` for the existing Session resource permission check. After that check passes, the handler does not require that Session to exist and does not return `session/not-found` solely because it is absent. No identity receives a separate history-scanning path.

The Client already holds the message's complete image reference and sends it as `attachment` beside `sessionId`. Session Controller delegates directly to the existing `AttachmentStore.readImage(ref)`. Its local provider validates the canonical ID, derives the path within its object directory, verifies SHA-256, and compares the actual format, byte length, width, and height with the supplied reference. A missing, unreadable, corrupt, or mismatched object rejects the operation. No Session history is needed to recover the reference.

The response preserves the supplied reference. Its optional `name` and `originalDimensions` are caller-supplied display information and are not verified against the stored object. The Client's existing historical-image cache continues to own per-Session results and object URLs; the Host adds no image-byte cache.

This rule narrows the readers covered by [Session observations](2026-08-25-session-observations-and-projection-owned-client-state.md) and the [history transport activation policy](2026-08-18-session-history-and-event-transport.md). [Workspace file reads](2026-09-05-workspace-files-service.md) keep their own filesystem authorization.
en.alt:
**Keep a Session-to-image map or projection.** An index removes repeated scans but preserves an access restriction the product does not require, adding derivation, lifetime, and invalidation work.

**Issue signed image tickets.** Tickets add issuance and validation state for the same unnecessary Session-membership restriction.

**Optimize only owner reads.** That gives identities different image-access semantics and leaves the scan cost for permitted non-owner callers without a product requirement.
en.cs:
Knowing a valid image reference and having permission to invoke the endpoint for the supplied Session resource permits reading that object across Sessions. The local ID is the SHA-256 of normalized bytes. For known PNG, JPEG, or WebP bytes that admission preserves unchanged, a caller can calculate the ID, derive the format, byte length, and dimensions, and use an authorized read to test whether the object exists. The required reference fields need not come from a Session log.

Image isolation requires separate Host instances with separate `DSH_HOME` directories. The shipped composition uses one attachment store per Host and does not select a store by Session. Authentication, Gateway action/resource checks, fixed storage paths, digest verification, and explicit failures remain required.

Image reads no longer depend on history length or Session materialization. File reading, integrity verification, encoding, and transport still cost time; this change makes no claim about upload or model inference latency. Existing Session data and fork references need no migration.

zh.t: 图片读取使用附件存储访问权限
zh.p: 历史图片加载会为每个未缓存的附件读取请求中的 Session，并搜索其事件内容。搜索用于确认 Session 引用了图片；它不负责定位字节，存储路径已经能由内容寻址 ID 推导。每次读图因此增加了与历史长度成正比的工作。用户反馈的加载延迟还涉及上传；这项发现本身不能确定全部延迟的来源。
zh.dc:
Session 关联不构成图片访问限制。连接身份认证和 Gateway 权限检查允许调用 `session/attachment` 后，任何调用者都可以通过完整的 `ImageAttachmentRef` 读取同一附件存储中的任意图片，包括仅被其他 Session 引用或未被任何 Session 引用的对象。请求保留 `sessionId`，供现有 Session 资源权限检查使用。该检查通过后，处理函数不要求该 Session 存在，也不会仅因其不存在而返回 `session/not-found`。所有身份使用相同的读图路径。

Client 已经持有消息中的完整图片引用，将其作为 `attachment` 与 `sessionId` 一起发送。Session Controller 直接调用已有的 `AttachmentStore.readImage(ref)`。本地提供方校验规范 ID，在自己的对象目录内推导路径，校验 SHA-256，并把实际格式、字节数、宽度和高度与传入引用比对。对象缺失、不可读、损坏或与引用不符时，操作失败。取得引用无需查询 Session 历史。

响应保留传入引用。可选的 `name` 和 `originalDimensions` 是调用方提交的显示信息，不根据存储对象校验。Client 现有的历史图片缓存继续按 Session 管理结果和对象 URL；Host 不增加图片字节缓存。

该规则缩小了 [Session observation](2026-08-25-session-observations-and-projection-owned-client-state.zh.md) 与[历史传输激活策略](2026-08-18-session-history-and-event-transport.zh.md)涵盖的读取范围。[工作区文件读取](2026-09-05-workspace-files-service.zh.md)保留自己的文件系统授权。
zh.alt:
**保留 Session 到图片的 Map 或 projection。** 索引可以消除重复扫描，但保留了产品不需要的访问限制，并增加派生、生命周期和失效处理。

**签发图片签名票据。** 票据为同一项不需要的 Session 关联限制增加签发和验证状态。

**只优化 owner 的读取。** 这会让不同身份使用不同的图片访问规则，并让获准调用的非 owner 继续承担扫描成本，没有相应产品需求。
zh.cs:
调用方知道有效图片引用，且有权为请求中的 Session 资源调用该接口，就可以跨 Session 读取对象。本地 ID 是规范化字节的 SHA-256。对于准入时原样保留的已知 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP 字节，调用方可以计算 ID，取得格式、字节数和尺寸，并通过获准的读取请求探测对象是否存在。这些必需的引用字段不一定来自 Session 日志。

图片隔离需要独立 Host 实例及各自的 `DSH_HOME` 目录。随附组合在每个 Host 中使用一个附件存储，不会按 Session 选择存储。身份认证、Gateway 操作与资源检查、固定存储路径、摘要校验和明确失败仍是必需的。

图片读取不再依赖历史长度或 Session 物化。文件读取、完整性校验、编码和传输仍有耗时；本次改动不说明上传或模型推理延迟已得到改善。已有 Session 数据和 fork 引用无需迁移。

en.t: macOS consent shared by bundle identifier
en.p: Users who install multiple versions of one application want one permission decision for that software. Executable paths split those decisions, and signing checks exclude unsigned development applications from saved access.
en.dc:
macOS application consent uses the exact, case-sensitive native bundle identifier. The helper hashes `macos:bundle-id:` followed by that identifier into `CuaApplicationId`. When a bundle identifier exists, installation paths, versions and signatures do not distinguish grants. Otherwise, the helper hashes `macos:executable-path:` followed by the canonical executable path. Both identities support saved access; path identities survive restart and in-place updates, while a different path requires a new decision. Conversation decisions and saved grants retain the scopes and revocation behavior of [profile consent storage](2026-10-19-cua-profile-consent-storage.md).

This supersedes the executable/signature identity choice in [application consent](2026-09-26-cua-application-consent.md); that note still owns enforcement and human decisions. The running process path comes from the operating system. A valid runtime bundle identifier does not depend on path-query success. Missing paths omit optional grant metadata; they never substitute a cached catalog path. When both bundle identity and process path are unavailable, consent fails with the path query cause. Process identity must still be verified, and any available process path must match the selected target. Missing catalog path metadata does not block consent when the process path is available. If the runtime bundle identifier is unavailable, a reported application bundle can supply it only when its main executable matches the process path; otherwise the executable path identifies the grant. Native process, executable-location and window checks continue to bind each handle to its selected target. Launch checks reread the bundle identifier and executable path from disk; they do not fingerprint executable content. Replacing bytes at the same path while retaining the identifier or path identity therefore retains consent, including during an approval wait.

The identity prefixes separate new grants from old path/signature, process-instance and executable-content digests. Old grants remain removable but do not grant access to new bundle identities; users decide again before permission covers other installations.

Apple’s [PPPC configuration](https://support.apple.com/guide/deployment/privacy-preferences-policy-control-payload-dep38df53c2a/web) supports bundle-ID or path selectors and separately requires a code-signing requirement. [TN3127](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/technotes/tn3127-inside-code-signing-requirements) explains that designated requirements track code identity across versions, while unsigned and ad-hoc code cannot provide the same stability. DSH adopts the selector alternatives for application management without requiring publisher authentication.
en.alt:
**Bundle identifier and path.** This distinguishes installed copies but requires separate decisions for the multiple versions the user wants to authorize together.

**Bundle identifiers only.** Missing identifiers would exclude otherwise usable applications from saved access. Canonical executable paths supply a stable fallback without using a PID or content hash.

**Verified signing identity.** This distinguishes publishers but denies saved access when signing is absent or cannot be verified. Publisher authentication is outside this application-management policy.
en.cs:
Another program declaring the same bundle identifier or replacing an executable at its approved fallback path inherits consent, including a program created or changed through separately authorized model tools. The worst consequence is observing or controlling an application that the user did not approve separately, within its available data and capabilities. The model cannot supply the authorization identity through the CUA request; the native helper reads it from the selected application. Different bundle identifiers require different decisions, even when users consider them versions of one product.

Revocation applies to every installation sharing the identifier. Tests exercise unsigned copies, different identifiers, missing identifiers with persistent path consent, process restarts, symlink aliases, pending and running identity agreement, shared handle revocation and refusal to widen old grants.

zh.t: 按 Bundle ID 共用 macOS 应用授权
zh.p: 用户安装同一应用的多个版本时，希望对这个软件只做一次权限决定。可执行文件路径会拆分这些决定，签名检查也会让未签名的开发版应用无法保存长期授权。
zh.dc:
macOS 应用授权使用原生应用提供的、区分大小写的完整 Bundle ID。helper 将 `macos:bundle-id:` 和该标识连接后计算摘要，生成 `CuaApplicationId`。有 Bundle ID 时，安装路径、版本和签名不区分授权。否则，helper 对 `macos:executable-path:` 与规范化可执行路径计算摘要。两种身份都支持长期许可；路径身份在重启和原地更新后保持不变，另一个路径需要新的决定。会话决定和长期许可保留[profile 授权存储](2026-10-19-cua-profile-consent-storage.zh.md)规定的范围和撤销行为。

本决策取代[应用授权](2026-09-26-cua-application-consent.zh.md)中的可执行文件和签名身份选择，原记录仍负责执行检查与用户决定。运行进程的可执行路径由操作系统提供。有效的运行时 Bundle ID 不依赖路径查询成功。无法取得路径时省略授权记录中的可选路径信息，不用缓存的应用目录路径代替。Bundle ID 和实际路径均不可用时，授权失败并报告路径查询原因。进程身份仍须验证，可取得的实际路径仍须与所选目标一致。只要能取得实际进程路径，应用目录信息中缺少路径不会阻止授权。运行时无法取得 Bundle ID 时，仅在其报告的应用 bundle 主可执行文件与进程路径一致时读取该标识，否则按可执行路径识别授权。原生进程、可执行文件位置和窗口检查继续把每个句柄绑定到所选目标。启动检查从磁盘重新读取 Bundle ID 和可执行路径，但不计算可执行内容指纹。因此，在相同路径下替换内容且保留相同标识或路径身份时，许可仍会沿用，包括等待用户批准期间的替换。

身份前缀将新授权与旧的路径和签名、进程实例、可执行内容摘要分开。旧授权仍可撤销，但不能授予新 Bundle ID 身份访问权限；许可覆盖其他安装副本前，需要用户重新决定。

Apple 的 [PPPC 配置](https://support.apple.com/guide/deployment/privacy-preferences-policy-control-payload-dep38df53c2a/web)支持 Bundle ID 或路径选择条件，同时另行要求代码签名条件。[TN3127](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/technotes/tn3127-inside-code-signing-requirements)说明了指定要求如何跨版本识别代码，以及未签名和临时签名代码无法提供同等稳定性。DSH 采用这两种选择条件管理应用，不要求验证发布者身份。
zh.alt:
**Bundle ID 加路径。** 可以区分安装副本，但用户希望共同授权的多个版本仍需分别确认。

**仅使用 Bundle ID。** 缺少标识会让本可操作的应用无法获得长期许可。规范化可执行路径提供稳定的后备标识，无须使用进程号或内容摘要。

**验证签名身份。** 可以区分发布者，但没有签名或验签失败时无法保存长期授权。发布者身份验证不属于本项应用管理规则。
zh.cs:
其他程序声明相同 Bundle ID，或替换路径授权对应的可执行文件时，会继承许可，包括通过其他已授权模型工具创建或修改的程序。最坏后果是在应用已有数据和能力范围内，读取或控制用户未单独批准的程序。模型不能在 CUA 请求中提交授权身份，该身份由原生 helper 从实际选中的应用读取。不同 Bundle ID 仍需分别授权，即使用户将它们视为同一产品的不同版本。

撤销作用于同一标识的所有安装副本。测试覆盖未签名副本、不同标识、缺少标识时的持久路径许可、进程重启、符号链接、启动前后身份一致、多个句柄共同撤销，以及不扩大旧授权。
